chapters.summary: The LORD commands Moses to take a census of all men twenty years old and older who are able to go to war, tribe by tribe. The total count of Israel's fighting men is 603,550; the Levites are excluded from the military census and assigned to care for the tabernacle.

chapters.summary: The LORD arranges the twelve tribes into four camps of three tribes each around the tabernacle, each under its own standard. Judah's camp is on the east, Reuben's on the south, Ephraim's on the west, and Dan's on the north, with the Levites camped in the middle.

verses.kjv: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation shall be the tabernacle, and the tent, the covering thereof, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
verses.modern: the guard duty of the sons of Gershon in the tent of meeting involved the tabernacle and the tent, its covering and the screen for the entrance of the tent of meeting,

verses.kjv: And the hangings of the court, and the curtain for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof.
verses.modern: the hangings of the court, the screen for the gate of the court that is around the tabernacle and the altar, and its cords — all the service relating to these.

verses.kjv: And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izeharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.
verses.modern: from Kohath came the clan of the Amramites, the clan of the Izharites, the clan of the Hebronites, and the clan of the Uzzielites; these are the clans of the Kohathites.

verses.kjv: In the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.
verses.modern: According to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, there were 8,600, keeping guard over the sanctuary.

verses.kjv: The families of the sons of Kohath shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle southward.
verses.modern: The clans of the sons of Kohath were to camp on the south side of the tabernacle,

verses.kjv: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
verses.modern: with Elizaphan the son of Uzziel as chief of the fathers' house of the clans of the Kohathites.

verses.kjv: And their charge shall be the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary wherewith they minister, and the hanging, and all the service thereof.
verses.modern: their guard duty involved the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the vessels of the sanctuary with which the priests minister, and the screen; all the service relating to these.

verses.kjv: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be chief over the chief of the Levites, and have the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.
verses.modern: Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest was to be chief over the chiefs of the Levites, and to have oversight of those who kept guard over the sanctuary.

verses.kjv: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.
verses.modern: From Merari came the clan of the Mahlites and the clan of the Mushites; these are the clans of Merari.

verses.kjv: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand and two hundred.
verses.modern: According to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, those listed were 6,200.

verses.kjv: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail: these shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle northward.
verses.modern: the chief of the fathers' house of the clans of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail; they were to camp on the north side of the tabernacle.

verses.kjv: And under the custody and charge of the sons of Merari shall be the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the vessels thereof, and all that serveth thereto,
verses.modern: the appointed guard duty of the sons of Merari involved the frames of the tabernacle, the bars, the pillars, the bases. All their accessories — all the service relating to these;

verses.kjv: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.
verses.modern: also the pillars around the court with their bases, pegs, and cords.

verses.kjv: But those that encamp before the tabernacle toward the east, even before the tabernacle of the congregation eastward, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.modern: those who were to camp before the tabernacle on the east, before the tent of meeting toward the sunrise, were Moses and Aaron and his sons, guarding the sanctuary itself, to protect the children of Israel. And any outsider who came near was to be put to death.

verses.kjv: All that were numbered of the Levites, which Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of the LORD, throughout their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty and two thousand.
verses.modern: All those listed of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron listed at the commandment of the LORD, by clans, all the males from a month old and upward, were 22,000.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Number all the firstborn of the males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.
verses.modern: the LORD said to Moses, 'List all the firstborn males of the children of Israel, from a month old and upward, taking the number of their names.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I am the LORD) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel.
verses.modern: you shall take the Levites for me — I am the LORD — instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the cattle of the children of Israel.'

verses.kjv: And Moses numbered, as the LORD commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
verses.modern: So Moses listed all the firstborn among the children of Israel, as the LORD commanded Him.

verses.kjv: And all the firstborn males by the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and threescore and thirteen.
verses.modern: all the firstborn males, according to the number of names, from a month old and upward, as listed, were 22,273.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I am the LORD.
verses.modern: 'Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle. The Levites shall be mine: I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: And for those that are to be redeemed of the two hundred and threescore and thirteen of the firstborn of the children of Israel, which are more than the Levites;
verses.modern: as the ransom for the 273 of the firstborn of the children of Israel, over and above the number of the Levites,

verses.kjv: Thou shalt even take five shekels apiece by the poll, after the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take them: (the shekel is twenty gerahs:)
verses.modern: you shall take five shekels per head; You shall take them according to the shekel of the sanctuary (the shekel of twenty gerahs),

verses.kjv: And thou shalt give the money, wherewith the odd number of them is to be redeemed, unto Aaron and to his sons.
verses.modern: give the money to Aaron and his sons as the ransom for those who are over.'

verses.kjv: And Moses took the redemption money of them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levites:
verses.modern: So Moses took the redemption money from those who were over and above those redeemed by the Levites.

verses.kjv: Of the firstborn of the children of Israel took he the money; a thousand three hundred and threescore and five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.modern: From the firstborn of the children of Israel he took the money, 1,365 shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.

verses.kjv: And Moses gave the money of them that were redeemed unto Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.modern: Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and his sons, according to the word of the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.

chapters.summary: The LORD takes the Levites in place of all the firstborn of Israel, numbering 22,000 Levite males from a month old and upward. The clans of Gershon, Kohath, and Merari are each assigned positions around the tabernacle and specific duties for its care; the 273 excess firstborn are redeemed with silver.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

verses.kjv: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, by the house of their fathers,
verses.modern: 'Take a census of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their clans and their fathers' houses,

verses.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.modern: from thirty years old up to fifty years old, all who can come on duty, to do the work in the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: This shall be the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation, about the most holy things:
verses.modern: This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the tent of meeting: the most holy things.

verses.kjv: And when the camp setteth forward, Aaron shall come, and his sons, and they shall take down the covering vail, and cover the ark of testimony with it:
verses.modern: When the camp is to set out, Aaron and his sons shall go in and take down the veil of the screen and cover the ark of the testimony with it.

verses.kjv: And shall put thereon the covering of badgers' skins, and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in the staves thereof.
verses.modern: Then they shall put on it a covering of goatskin and spread on top of that a cloth all of blue, and shall put its poles in place.

verses.kjv: And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls, and covers to cover withal: and the continual bread shall be thereon:
verses.modern: over the table of the bread of the Presence they shall spread a cloth of blue and put on it the plates, the dishes for incense, the bowls, and the flagons for the drink offering; the regular showbread also shall be on it.

verses.kjv: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put in the staves thereof.
verses.modern: Then they shall spread over them a cloth of scarlet and cover the same with a covering of goatskin, and shall put in its poles.

verses.kjv: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and his lamps, and his tongs, and his snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:
verses.modern: they shall take a cloth of blue and cover the lampstand for the light, with its lamps, its tongs, its trays. All the vessels for oil with which it is tended.

verses.kjv: And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put it upon a bar.
verses.modern: they shall put it with all its utensils in a covering of goatskin and put it on the carrying frame.

verses.kjv: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put to the staves thereof:
verses.modern: over the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue and cover it with a covering of goatskin, and shall put in its poles.

verses.kjv: And they shall take all the instruments of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put them on a bar:
verses.modern: they shall take all the vessels of the service that are used in the sanctuary and put them in a cloth of blue and cover them with a covering of goatskin and put them on the carrying frame.

verses.kjv: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:
verses.modern: they shall remove the ashes from the altar and spread a purple cloth over it.

verses.kjv: And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, even the censers, the fleshhooks, and the shovels, and the basons, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers' skins, and put to the staves of it.
verses.modern: shall put on it all the utensils of the altar that are used for the service at the altar — the fire pans, the forks, the shovels, and the basins, all the utensils of the altar — and they shall spread on it a covering of goatskin, and shall put its poles in place.

verses.kjv: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch any holy thing, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.modern: when Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furnishings of the sanctuary, as the camp sets out, after that the sons of Kohath shall come to carry these. But They must not touch the holy things, lest they die. These are the things of the tent of meeting that the sons of Kohath are to carry.

verses.kjv: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest pertaineth the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily meat offering, and the anointing oil, and the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein is, in the sanctuary, and in the vessels thereof.
verses.modern: Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall have charge of the oil for the light, the fragrant incense, the regular grain offering, and the anointing oil, with oversight of all the tabernacle and all that is in it, of the sanctuary and its vessels.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

verses.kjv: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites:
verses.modern: 'Let not the tribe of the clans of the Kohathites be destroyed from among the Levites,

verses.kjv: But thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:
verses.modern: but deal with them in this way that they may live and not die when they come near to the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in and appoint them each to his task and to his burden.

verses.kjv: But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.
verses.modern: But they shall not go in to look on the holy things even for a moment, lest they die.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, throughout the houses of their fathers, by their families;
verses.modern: 'Take a census of the sons of Gershon also, by their fathers' houses and by their clans.

verses.kjv: From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.modern: From thirty years old up to fifty years old, You shall list them, all who can come to do duty, to do service in the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, to serve, and for burdens:
verses.modern: This is the service of the clans of the Gershonites, in serving and bearing burdens.

verses.kjv: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of the congregation, his covering, and the covering of the badgers' skins that is above upon it, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
verses.modern: They shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle and the tent of meeting with its covering and the covering of goatskin that is on top of it and the screen for the entrance of the tent of meeting

verses.kjv: And the hangings of the court, and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them: so shall they serve.
verses.modern: the hangings of the court and the screen for the gate of the court that is around the tabernacle and the altar. Their cords and all the equipment for their service. And they shall do all that needs to be done with regard to them.

verses.kjv: At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burdens, and in all their service: and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burdens.
verses.modern: All the service of the sons of the Gershonites shall be at the command of Aaron and his sons, in all that they are to carry and in all that they have to do. And you shall assign to their charge all that they are to carry.

verses.kjv: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation: and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.modern: This is the service of the clans of the sons of Gershon in the tent of meeting. Their guard duty is to be under the direction of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

verses.kjv: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them after their families, by the house of their fathers;
verses.modern: As for the sons of Merari, you shall list them by their clans and their fathers' houses.

verses.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth into the service, to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.modern: From thirty years old up to fifty years old, you shall list them, everyone who can come on duty, to do the service of the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: And this is the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation; the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and sockets thereof,
verses.modern: this is what they are charged to carry, as the whole of their service in the tent of meeting: the frames of the tabernacle, with its bars, pillars, and bases,

verses.kjv: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name ye shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden.
verses.modern: the pillars around the court with their bases, pegs, and cords, with all their equipment and all their accessories. And you shall list by name the objects that they are required to carry.

verses.kjv: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tabernacle of the congregation, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.modern: This is the service of the clans of the sons of Merari, the whole of their service in the tent of meeting, under the direction of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.'

verses.kjv: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
verses.modern: Moses and Aaron and the chiefs of the congregation listed the sons of the Kohathites, by their clans and their fathers' houses,

verses.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.modern: from thirty years old up to fifty years old, everyone who could come on duty, for service in the tent of meeting;

verses.kjv: And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.
verses.modern: those listed of them by their clans were 2,750.

verses.kjv: These were they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
verses.modern: These were the people listed of the clans of the Kohathites, all who served in the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron listed according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.

verses.kjv: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, throughout their families, and by the house of their fathers,
verses.modern: Those listed of the sons of Gershon, by their clans and their fathers' houses,

verses.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.modern: from thirty years old up to fifty years old, everyone who could come on duty for service in the tent of meeting —

verses.kjv: Even those that were numbered of them, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.
verses.modern: those listed by their clans and fathers' houses were 2,630.

verses.kjv: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, whom Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD.
verses.modern: These are the people listed of the clans of the sons of Gershon, all who served in the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron listed according to the commandment of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers,
verses.modern: Those listed of the clans of the sons of Merari, by their clans and their fathers' houses,

verses.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.modern: from thirty years old up to fifty years old, everyone who could come on duty for service in the tent of meeting —

verses.kjv: Even those that were numbered of them after their families, were three thousand and two hundred.
verses.modern: those listed by their clans were 3,200.

verses.kjv: These be those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
verses.modern: These are those listed of the clans of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron listed according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.

verses.kjv: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered, after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
verses.modern: All those who were listed of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the chiefs of Israel listed, by their clans and their fathers' houses,

verses.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that came to do the service of the ministry, and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation,
verses.modern: from thirty years old up to fifty years old, everyone who could come to do the service of ministry and the service of bearing burdens in the tent of meeting —

verses.kjv: Even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore.
verses.modern: those listed were 8,580.

verses.kjv: According to the commandment of the LORD they were numbered by the hand of Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered of him, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.modern: According to the commandment of the LORD, through Moses, each one was listed to his specific task of serving or carrying; thus they were listed by Moses, as the LORD commanded Him.

chapters.summary: The LORD gives instructions for the service of the Levite clans when the camp moves. The Kohathites carry the holy objects after Aaron's sons cover them, the Gershonites carry the curtains and coverings, and the Merarites carry the frames and pillars; the total number of Levites in service is 8,580.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whosoever is defiled by the dead:
verses.modern: 'Command the children of Israel to put out of the camp every person with a skin disease and every person with a discharge and everyone who is unclean through contact with the dead.

verses.kjv: Both male and female shall ye put out, without the camp shall ye put them; that they defile not their camps, in the midst whereof I dwell.
verses.modern: You shall put out both male and female, putting them outside the camp, that they may not defile their camp, in the midst of which I dwell.'

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out without the camp: as the LORD spake unto Moses, so did the children of Israel.
verses.modern: the children of Israel did so, and put them outside the camp; as the LORD said to Moses, so the children of Israel did.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, to do a trespass against the LORD, and that person be guilty;
verses.modern: 'Speak to the children of Israel, When a man or woman commits any of the sins that people commit by breaking faith with the LORD, and that person realizes His guilt,

verses.kjv: Then they shall confess their sin which they have done: and he shall recompense his trespass with the principal thereof, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him against whom he hath trespassed.
verses.modern: he shall confess His sin that He has committed. And He shall make full restitution for His wrong, adding a fifth to it and giving it to Him to whom He did the wrong.

verses.kjv: But if the man have no kinsman to recompense the trespass unto, let the trespass be recompensed unto the LORD, even to the priest; beside the ram of the atonement, whereby an atonement shall be made for him.
verses.modern: But if the man has no kinsman to whom restitution may be made for the wrong, the restitution for wrong shall go to the LORD for the priest, in addition to the ram of atonement with which atonement is made for Him.

verses.kjv: And every offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they bring unto the priest, shall be his.
verses.modern: every contribution, all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they bring to the priest, shall be his.

verses.kjv: And every man's hallowed things shall be his: whatsoever any man giveth the priest, it shall be his.
verses.modern: Each one shall keep his own holy things: whatever anyone gives to the priest shall be his.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man's wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him,
verses.modern: 'Speak to the children of Israel, If any man's wife goes astray and breaks faith with Him,

verses.kjv: And a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept close, and she be defiled, and there be no witness against her, neither she be taken with the manner;
verses.modern: if a man lies with her sexually. It is hidden from the eyes of her husband. She is undetected though she has defiled herself, and there is no witness against her, since she was not caught in the act,

verses.kjv: And the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be not defiled:
verses.modern: if the spirit of jealousy comes over Him and He is jealous of his wife who has defiled herself, or if the spirit of jealousy comes over Him and He is jealous of his wife, though she has not defiled herself,

verses.kjv: Then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest, and he shall bring her offering for her, the tenth part of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it is an offering of jealousy, an offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.
verses.modern: then the man shall bring his wife to the priest and bring the offering required of her, a tenth of an ephah of barley flour. He shall pour no oil on it and put no frankincense on it, for it is a grain offering of jealousy, a grain offering of remembrance, bringing iniquity to remembrance.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before the LORD:
verses.modern: the priest shall bring her near and set her before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is in the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water:
verses.modern: the priest shall take holy water in an earthenware vessel and take some of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle and put it into the water.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall set the woman before the LORD, and uncover the woman's head, and put the offering of memorial in her hands, which is the jealousy offering: and the priest shall have in his hand the bitter water that causeth the curse:
verses.modern: the priest shall set the woman before the LORD and unbind the hair of the woman's head and place in her hands the grain offering of remembrance, which is the grain offering of jealousy. And in His hand the priest shall have the water of bitterness that brings the curse.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall charge her by an oath, and say unto the woman, If no man have lain with thee, and if thou hast not gone aside to uncleanness with another instead of thy husband, be thou free from this bitter water that causeth the curse:
verses.modern: Then the priest shall make her take an oath, saying to her, If no man has lain with you, and if you have not turned aside to uncleanness while under your husband's authority, be free from this water of bitterness that brings the curse.

verses.kjv: But if thou hast gone aside to another instead of thy husband, and if thou be defiled, and some man have lain with thee beside thine husband:
verses.modern: But if you have gone astray, though you are under your husband's authority, and if you have defiled yourself. Some man other than your husband has lain with you,

verses.kjv: Then the priest shall charge the woman with an oath of cursing, and the priest shall say unto the woman, The LORD make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when the LORD doth make thy thigh to rot, and thy belly to swell;
verses.modern: then (the priest shall make the woman take the oath of the curse, and the priest shall say to the woman), the LORD make You a curse and an oath among Your people, when the LORD makes Your thigh fall away and Your body swell.

verses.kjv: And this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels, to make thy belly to swell, and thy thigh to rot: And the woman shall say, Amen, amen.
verses.modern: May this water that brings the curse pass into your bowels and make your womb swell and your thigh fall away. And the woman shall say, Amen, Amen.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot them out with the bitter water:
verses.modern: Then the priest shall write these curses in a book and wash them off into the water of bitterness.

verses.kjv: And he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that causeth the curse: and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter.
verses.modern: he shall make the woman drink the water of bitterness that brings the curse, and the water that brings the curse shall enter into her and cause bitter pain.

verses.kjv: Then the priest shall take the jealousy offering out of the woman's hand, and shall wave the offering before the LORD, and offer it upon the altar:
verses.modern: the priest shall take the grain offering of jealousy out of the woman's hand and shall wave the grain offering before the LORD and bring it to the altar.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall take an handful of the offering, even the memorial thereof, and burn it upon the altar, and afterward shall cause the woman to drink the water.
verses.modern: the priest shall take a handful of the grain offering, as its memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, and afterward shall make the woman drink the water.

verses.kjv: And when he hath made her to drink the water, then it shall come to pass, that, if she be defiled, and have done trespass against her husband, that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall rot: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.
verses.modern: when he has made her drink the water, then, if she has defiled herself and has broken faith with her husband, the water that brings the curse shall enter into her and cause bitter pain. Her womb shall swell. Her thigh shall fall away, and the woman shall become a curse among her people.

verses.kjv: And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.
verses.modern: But if the woman has not defiled herself and is clean, then she shall be free and shall conceive children.

verses.kjv: This is the law of jealousies, when a wife goeth aside to another instead of her husband, and is defiled;
verses.modern: This is the law in cases of jealousy, when a wife, though under her husband's authority, goes astray and defiles herself,

verses.kjv: Or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon him, and he be jealous over his wife, and shall set the woman before the LORD, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.

verses.kjv: Then shall the man be guiltless from iniquity, and this woman shall bear her iniquity.
verses.modern: The man shall be free from iniquity, but the woman shall bear her iniquity.'

chapters.summary: The LORD commands the removal of unclean persons from the camp and gives laws requiring restitution for wrongs. He then gives the law of jealousy -- a test by bitter water to determine whether a wife has been unfaithful to her husband.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: He shall separate himself from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.
verses.modern: he shall abstain from wine and strong drink. He shall drink no vinegar made from wine or strong drink and shall not drink any juice of grapes or eat grapes, fresh or dried.

verses.kjv: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk.
verses.modern: All the days of His separation He shall eat nothing produced by the grapevine, not even the seeds or the skins.

verses.kjv: All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until the days be fulfilled, in the which he separateth himself unto the LORD, he shall be holy, and shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.
verses.modern: All the days of His vow of separation, no razor shall come upon His head. Until the time is completed for which He separates Himself to the LORD, He shall be holy. He shall let the locks of hair on His head grow long.

verses.kjv: All the days that he separateth himself unto the LORD he shall come at no dead body.
verses.modern: All the days that He separates Himself to the LORD He shall not go near a dead body.

verses.kjv: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die: because the consecration of his God is upon his head.
verses.modern: Not even for His father or for His mother, for brother or sister, if they die, shall He make Himself unclean, because His separation to God is on His head.

verses.kjv: All the days of his separation he is holy unto the LORD.
verses.modern: All the days of His separation He is holy to the LORD.

verses.modern: if any man dies very suddenly beside Him and He defiles His consecrated head, then He shall shave His head on the day of His cleansing; on the seventh day He shall shave it.

verses.kjv: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

chapters.summary: The LORD gives the law of the Nazirite vow: the person must abstain from wine, not cut his hair, and avoid contact with the dead for the duration of the vow. The chapter concludes with the Aaronic blessing: 'The LORD bless thee, and keep thee.'
