verses.kjv: On the eleventh day Pagiel the son of Ocran, prince of the children of Asher, offered:
verses.modern: On the eleventh day Pagiel the son of Ocran, the chief of the people of Asher:

verses.kjv: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
verses.modern: his offering was one silver plate whose weight was 130 shekels, one silver basin of 70 shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering;

verses.kjv: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
verses.modern: one golden dish of 10 shekels, full of incense;

verses.kjv: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.modern: one bull from the herd, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

verses.kjv: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.modern: one male goat for a sin offering;

verses.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.modern: for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Pagiel the son of Ocran.

verses.kjv: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, prince of the children of Naphtali, offered:
verses.modern: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, the chief of the people of Naphtali:

verses.kjv: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
verses.modern: his offering was one silver plate whose weight was 130 shekels, one silver basin of 70 shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering;

verses.kjv: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
verses.modern: one golden dish of 10 shekels, full of incense;

verses.kjv: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.modern: one bull from the herd, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

verses.kjv: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.modern: one male goat for a sin offering;

verses.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.modern: for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.

verses.kjv: This was the dedication of the altar, in the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve chargers of silver, twelve silver bowls, twelve spoons of gold:
verses.modern: This was the dedication offering for the altar on the day when it was anointed, from the chiefs of Israel: twelve silver plates, twelve silver basins, twelve golden dishes,

verses.kjv: Each charger of silver weighing an hundred and thirty shekels, each bowl seventy: all the silver vessels weighed two thousand and four hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
verses.modern: each silver plate weighing 130 shekels and each basin 70, all the silver of the vessels 2,400 shekels by the shekel of the sanctuary,

verses.kjv: The golden spoons were twelve, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary: all the gold of the spoons was an hundred and twenty shekels.
verses.modern: the twelve golden dishes, full of incense, weighing 10 shekels apiece by the shekel of the sanctuary, all the gold of the dishes being 120 shekels;

verses.kjv: All the oxen for the burnt offering were twelve bullocks, the rams twelve, the lambs of the first year twelve, with their meat offering: and the kids of the goats for sin offering twelve.
verses.modern: all the cattle for the burnt offering twelve bulls, twelve rams, twelve male lambs a year old, with their grain offering. Twelve male goats for a sin offering;

verses.kjv: And all the oxen for the sacrifice of the peace offerings were twenty and four bullocks, the rams sixty, the he goats sixty, the lambs of the first year sixty. This was the dedication of the altar, after that it was anointed.
verses.modern: all the cattle for the sacrifice of peace offerings twenty-four bulls, the rams sixty, the male goats sixty, the male lambs a year old sixty. This was the dedication offering for the altar after it was anointed.

verses.kjv: And when Moses was gone into the tabernacle of the congregation to speak with him, then he heard the voice of one speaking unto him from off the mercy seat that was upon the ark of testimony, from between the two cherubims: and he spake unto him.
verses.modern: when Moses went into the tent of meeting to speak with the LORD, He heard the voice speaking to Him from above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the testimony, from between the two cherubim. It spoke to Him.

chapters.summary: The twelve tribal leaders bring offerings for the dedication of the altar over twelve days, each leader bringing identical gifts on his appointed day. Their offerings include silver plates, golden dishes of incense, bulls, rams, lambs, and goats.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto Aaron, and say unto him, When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light over against the candlestick.
verses.modern: 'Speak to Aaron and say to him, When you set up the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lampstand.'

verses.kjv: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof over against the candlestick, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.modern: Aaron did so: he set up its lamps in front of the lampstand, as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And this work of the candlestick was of beaten gold, unto the shaft thereof, unto the flowers thereof, was beaten work: according unto the pattern which the LORD had shewed Moses, so he made the candlestick.
verses.modern: this was the workmanship of the lampstand, hammered work of gold. From its base to its flowers, it was hammered work; according to the pattern that the LORD had shown Moses, so he made the lampstand.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.
verses.modern: 'Take the Levites from among the people of Israel and cleanse them.

verses.kjv: And thus shalt thou do unto them, to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purifying upon them, and let them shave all their flesh, and let them wash their clothes, and so make themselves clean.
verses.modern: this is what You shall do to them to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of purification on them, and let them shave all their body and wash their clothes and cleanse themselves.

verses.kjv: Then let them take a young bullock with his meat offering, even fine flour mingled with oil, and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin offering.
verses.modern: Then let them take a bull from the herd and its grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, and You shall take another bull from the herd for a sin offering.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt gather the whole assembly of the children of Israel together:
verses.modern: you shall bring the Levites before the tent of meeting and assemble the whole congregation of the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the LORD: and the children of Israel shall put their hands upon the Levites:
verses.modern: When You bring the Levites before the LORD, the people of Israel shall lay their hands on the Levites,

verses.kjv: And Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD for an offering of the children of Israel, that they may execute the service of the LORD.
verses.modern: Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD as a wave offering from the people of Israel, that they may do the service of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks: and thou shalt offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, unto the LORD, to make an atonement for the Levites.
verses.modern: Then the Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and You shall offer the one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering to the LORD to make atonement for the Levites.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them for an offering unto the LORD.
verses.modern: you shall set the Levites before Aaron and his sons, and shall offer them as a wave offering to the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be mine.
verses.modern: Thus You shall separate the Levites from among the people of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine.

verses.kjv: And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them for an offering.
verses.modern: after that the Levites shall go in to serve at the tent of meeting, when You have cleansed them and offered them as a wave offering.

verses.kjv: For they are wholly given unto me from among the children of Israel; instead of such as open every womb, even instead of the firstborn of all the children of Israel, have I taken them unto me.
verses.modern: For they are wholly given to me from among the people of Israel. Instead of all who open the womb, the firstborn of all the people of Israel, I have taken them for myself.

verses.kjv: For all the firstborn of the children of Israel are mine, both man and beast: on the day that I smote every firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for myself.
verses.modern: For all the firstborn among the people of Israel are mine, both of man and of beast. On the day that I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I consecrated them for myself,

verses.kjv: And I have taken the Levites for all the firstborn of the children of Israel.
verses.modern: I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn of the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tabernacle of the congregation, and to make an atonement for the children of Israel: that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come nigh unto the sanctuary.
verses.modern: I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and his sons from among the people of Israel, to do the service for the people of Israel at the tent of meeting and to make atonement for the people of Israel, that there may be no plague among the people of Israel when the people of Israel come near the sanctuary.'

verses.kjv: And Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, did to the Levites according unto all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did the children of Israel unto them.
verses.modern: Thus Moses and Aaron and all the congregation of the people of Israel did to the Levites. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, the people of Israel did to them.

verses.kjv: And the Levites were purified, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them as an offering before the LORD; and Aaron made an atonement for them to cleanse them.
verses.modern: the Levites purified themselves from sin and washed their clothes, and Aaron offered them as a wave offering before the LORD, and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.

verses.kjv: And after that went the Levites in to do their service in the tabernacle of the congregation before Aaron, and before his sons: as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they unto them.
verses.modern: after that the Levites went in to do their service in the tent of meeting before Aaron and his sons; as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: This is it that belongeth unto the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service of the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.modern: 'This applies to the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward they shall come to do duty in the service of the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: And from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the service thereof, and shall serve no more:
verses.modern: from the age of fifty years they shall withdraw from the duty of the service and serve no more.

verses.kjv: But shall minister with their brethren in the tabernacle of the congregation, to keep the charge, and shall do no service. Thus shalt thou do unto the Levites touching their charge.
verses.modern: They minister to their brothers in the tent of meeting by keeping guard. But They shall do no service. Thus shall You do to the Levites in assigning their duties.'

chapters.summary: The LORD instructs Moses to set up the lampstand and to consecrate the Levites for service by sprinkling them with water of purification, shaving their bodies, and offering sacrifices. The Levites are set apart from the rest of Israel as a wave offering to the LORD, serving in the tent of meeting from age twenty-five to fifty.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

verses.kjv: Let the children of Israel also keep the passover at his appointed season.
verses.modern: 'Let the people of Israel keep the Passover at its appointed time.

verses.kjv: In the fourteenth day of this month, at even, ye shall keep it in his appointed season: according to all the rites of it, and according to all the ceremonies thereof, shall ye keep it.
verses.modern: On the fourteenth day of this month, at twilight, You shall keep it at its appointed time; according to all its statutes and all its rules You shall keep it.'

verses.kjv: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, that they should keep the passover.
verses.modern: So Moses told the people of Israel that they should keep the Passover.

verses.kjv: And they kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month at even in the wilderness of Sinai: according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel.
verses.modern: they kept the Passover in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, at twilight, in the wilderness of Sinai; according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the people of Israel did.

verses.kjv: And there were certain men, who were defiled by the dead body of a man, that they could not keep the passover on that day: and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:
verses.modern: there were certain people who were unclean through touching a human corpse, so that they could not keep the Passover on that day. They came before Moses and Aaron on that day.

verses.kjv: And those men said unto him, We are defiled by the dead body of a man: wherefore are we kept back, that we may not offer an offering of the LORD in his appointed season among the children of Israel?
verses.modern: those men said to Him, 'We are unclean through touching a human corpse. Why are we kept from bringing the LORD's offering at its appointed time among the people of Israel?'

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto them, Stand still, and I will hear what the LORD will command concerning you.
verses.modern: Moses said to them, 'Wait, that I may hear what the LORD will command concerning You.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If any man of you or of your posterity shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or be in a journey afar off, yet he shall keep the passover unto the LORD.
verses.modern: 'Speak to the people of Israel, saying, If any one of you or of Your descendants is unclean through touching a dead body, or is on a long journey, He shall still keep the Passover to the LORD.

verses.kjv: The fourteenth day of the second month at even they shall keep it, and eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
verses.modern: In the second month on the fourteenth day at twilight they shall keep it. They shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

verses.kjv: They shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break any bone of it: according to all the ordinances of the passover they shall keep it.
verses.modern: They shall leave none of it until the morning, nor break any of its bones; according to all the statute for the Passover they shall keep it.

verses.kjv: But the man that is clean, and is not in a journey, and forbeareth to keep the passover, even the same soul shall be cut off from among his people: because he brought not the offering of the LORD in his appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.
verses.modern: But if a man is clean and is not on a journey, yet refrains from keeping the Passover, that person shall be cut off from His people because He did not bring the LORD's offering at its appointed time; that man shall bear his sin.

verses.kjv: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and will keep the passover unto the LORD; according to the ordinance of the passover, and according to the manner thereof, so shall he do: ye shall have one ordinance, both for the stranger, and for him that was born in the land.
verses.modern: if a stranger sojourns among You and would keep the Passover to the LORD, according to the statute of the Passover and according to its rule, so shall He do. You shall have one statute, both for the sojourner and for the native.'

verses.kjv: And on the day that the tabernacle was reared up the cloud covered the tabernacle, namely, the tent of the testimony: and at even there was upon the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until the morning.
verses.modern: On the day that the tabernacle was set up, the cloud covered the tabernacle, the tent of the testimony. And at evening it was over the tabernacle like the appearance of fire until morning.

verses.kjv: So it was alway: the cloud covered it by day, and the appearance of fire by night.
verses.modern: So it was always: the cloud covered it by day and the appearance of fire by night.

verses.kjv: And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Israel journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Israel pitched their tents.
verses.modern: whenever the cloud lifted from over the tent, after that the people of Israel set out, and in the place where the cloud settled down, there the people of Israel camped.

verses.kjv: At the commandment of the LORD the children of Israel journeyed, and at the commandment of the LORD they pitched: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they rested in their tents.
verses.modern: At the command of the LORD the people of Israel set out, and at the command of the LORD they camped. As long as the cloud rested over the tabernacle, they remained in camp.

verses.kjv: And when the cloud tarried long upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the charge of the LORD, and journeyed not.
verses.modern: Even when the cloud continued over the tabernacle many days, the people of Israel kept the charge of the LORD and did not set out.

verses.kjv: And so it was, when the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle; according to the commandment of the LORD they abode in their tents, and according to the commandment of the LORD they journeyed.
verses.modern: Sometimes the cloud was a few days over the tabernacle, and according to the command of the LORD they remained in camp; then according to the command of the LORD they set out.

verses.kjv: And so it was, when the cloud abode from even unto the morning, and that the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they journeyed: whether it was by day or by night that the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.
verses.modern: sometimes the cloud remained from evening until morning. And when the cloud lifted in the morning, they set out, or if it continued for a day and a night, when the cloud lifted they set out.

verses.kjv: Or whether it were two days, or a month, or a year, that the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle, remaining thereon, the children of Israel abode in their tents, and journeyed not: but when it was taken up, they journeyed.
verses.modern: Whether it was two days, or a month, or a longer time, that the cloud continued over the tabernacle, abiding there, the people of Israel remained in camp and did not set out, but when it lifted they set out.

verses.kjv: At the commandment of the LORD they rested in the tents, and at the commandment of the LORD they journeyed: they kept the charge of the LORD, at the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
verses.modern: At the command of the LORD they camped, and at the command of the LORD they set out. They kept the charge of the LORD, at the command of the LORD by Moses.

chapters.summary: The LORD commands Israel to keep the Passover in the wilderness of Sinai, and provides for those who are unclean or on a journey to keep it one month later. The cloud of the LORD covers the tabernacle, and whenever it lifts the people set out; whenever it settles, they camp.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Make thee two trumpets of silver; of a whole piece shalt thou make them: that thou mayest use them for the calling of the assembly, and for the journeying of the camps.
verses.modern: 'Make two silver trumpets. Of hammered work You shall make them, and You shall use them for summoning the congregation and for breaking camp.

verses.kjv: And when they shall blow with them, all the assembly shall assemble themselves to thee at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.modern: When both are blown, all the congregation shall gather themselves to You at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: And if they blow but with one trumpet, then the princes, which are heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves unto thee.
verses.modern: But if they blow only one, then the chiefs, the heads of the tribes of Israel, shall gather to You.

verses.kjv: When ye blow an alarm, then the camps that lie on the east parts shall go forward.
verses.modern: When You blow an alarm, the camps that are on the east side shall set out.

verses.kjv: When ye blow an alarm the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.
verses.modern: when You blow an alarm the second time, the camps that are on the south side shall set out. An alarm is to be blown whenever they are to set out.

verses.kjv: But when the congregation is to be gathered together, ye shall blow, but ye shall not sound an alarm.
verses.modern: But when the assembly is to be gathered together, You shall blow a long blast, but You shall not blow an alarm.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow with the trumpets; and they shall be to you for an ordinance for ever throughout your generations.
verses.modern: the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets. The trumpets shall be to you for a perpetual statute throughout your generations.

verses.kjv: And if ye go to war in your land against the enemy that oppresseth you, then ye shall blow an alarm with the trumpets; and ye shall be remembered before the LORD your God, and ye shall be saved from your enemies.
verses.modern: when You go to war in Your land against the adversary who oppresses you, then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets, that You may be remembered before the LORD Your God, and You shall be saved from Your enemies.

verses.kjv: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your solemn days, and in the beginnings of your months, ye shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; that they may be to you for a memorial before your God: I am the LORD your God.
verses.modern: On the day of Your gladness also, and at Your appointed feasts and at the beginnings of Your months, You shall blow the trumpets over Your burnt offerings and over the sacrifices of Your peace offerings. They shall be a reminder of You before Your God: I am the LORD Your God.'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the twentieth day of the second month, in the second year, that the cloud was taken up from off the tabernacle of the testimony.
verses.modern: In the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, the cloud lifted from over the tabernacle of the testimony,

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel took their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud rested in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.modern: the people of Israel set out by stages from the wilderness of Sinai. And the cloud settled down in the wilderness of Paran.

verses.kjv: And they first took their journey according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
verses.modern: They set out for the first time at the command of the LORD by Moses.

verses.kjv: In the first place went the standard of the camp of the children of Judah according to their armies: and over his host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.modern: The standard of the camp of the people of Judah set out first by their companies, and over their company was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

verses.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
verses.modern: over the company of the tribe of the people of Issachar was Nethanel the son of Zuar.

verses.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.
verses.modern: over the company of the tribe of the people of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.

verses.kjv: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set forward, bearing the tabernacle.
verses.modern: when the tabernacle was taken down, the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who carried the tabernacle, set out.

verses.kjv: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.modern: the standard of the camp of Reuben set out by their companies, and over their company was Elizur the son of Shedeur.

verses.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.modern: over the company of the tribe of the people of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

verses.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
verses.modern: over the company of the tribe of the people of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

verses.kjv: And the Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary: and the other did set up the tabernacle against they came.
verses.modern: Then the Kohathites set out, carrying the holy things, and the tabernacle was set up before their arrival.

verses.kjv: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elishama the son of Ammihud.
verses.modern: the standard of the camp of the people of Ephraim set out by their companies, and over their company was Elishama the son of Ammihud.

verses.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.modern: over the company of the tribe of the people of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

verses.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.modern: over the company of the tribe of the people of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.

verses.kjv: And the standard of the camp of the children of Dan set forward, which was the rereward of all the camps throughout their hosts: and over his host was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.modern: Then the standard of the camp of the people of Dan, acting as the rear guard of all the camps, set out by their companies, and over their company was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

verses.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.modern: over the company of the tribe of the people of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ocran.

verses.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.modern: over the company of the tribe of the people of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.

verses.kjv: Thus were the journeyings of the children of Israel according to their armies, when they set forward.
verses.modern: This was the order of march of the people of Israel by their companies, when they set out.

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto Hobab, the son of Raguel the Midianite, Moses' father in law, We are journeying unto the place of which the LORD said, I will give it you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good: for the LORD hath spoken good concerning Israel.
verses.modern: Moses said to Hobab the son of Raguel the Midianite, Moses' father-in-law, 'We are setting out for the place of which the LORD said, "I will give it to You." Come with us. We will do good to You, for the LORD has promised good to Israel.'

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, I will not go; but I will depart to mine own land, and to my kindred.
verses.modern: But He said to Him, 'I will not go. I will depart to my own land and to my family.'

verses.kjv: And he said, Leave us not, I pray thee; forasmuch as thou knowest how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and thou mayest be to us instead of eyes.
verses.modern: he said, 'Please do not leave us, for You know where we should camp in the wilderness, and You will serve as eyes for us.

verses.kjv: And it shall be, if thou go with us, yea, it shall be, that what goodness the LORD shall do unto us, the same will we do unto thee.
verses.modern: if You do go with us, whatever good the LORD will do to us, the same will we do to You.'

verses.kjv: And they departed from the mount of the LORD three days' journey: and the ark of the covenant of the LORD went before them in the three days' journey, to search out a resting place for them.
verses.modern: So they set out from the mount of the LORD three days' journey. And the ark of the covenant of the LORD went before them three days' journey, to seek out a resting place for them.

verses.kjv: And the cloud of the LORD was upon them by day, when they went out of the camp.
verses.modern: the cloud of the LORD was over them by day, whenever they set out from the camp.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, LORD, and let thine enemies be scattered; and let them that hate thee flee before thee.
verses.modern: whenever the ark set out, Moses said, 'Arise, O LORD, and let Your enemies be scattered, and let those who hate You flee before You.'

verses.kjv: And when it rested, he said, Return, O LORD, unto the many thousands of Israel.
verses.modern: when it rested, He said, 'Return, O LORD, to the ten thousand thousands of Israel.'

chapters.summary: The LORD commands Moses to make two silver trumpets for summoning the congregation and signaling the camps to march. Israel departs from Sinai in formation for the first time, and Moses asks Hobab his father-in-law to come with them as a guide.

verses.kjv: And when the people complained, it displeased the LORD: and the LORD heard it; and his anger was kindled; and the fire of the LORD burnt among them, and consumed them that were in the uttermost parts of the camp.
verses.modern: the people complained in the hearing of the LORD about their misfortunes, and when the LORD heard it, His anger was kindled, and the fire of the LORD burned among them and consumed some outlying parts of the camp.

verses.kjv: And the people cried unto Moses; and when Moses prayed unto the LORD, the fire was quenched.
verses.modern: Then the people cried out to Moses, and Moses prayed to the LORD, and the fire died out.

verses.kjv: And he called the name of that place Taberah: because the fire of the LORD burnt among them.
verses.modern: So the name of that place was called Taberah, because the fire of the LORD burned among them.

verses.kjv: And the mixt multitude that was among them fell a lusting: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?
verses.modern: Now the mixt multitude that was among them had a strong craving. And the people of Israel also wept again and said, 'Oh that we had meat to eat!

verses.kjv: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:
verses.modern: We remember the fish we ate in Egypt that cost nothing, the cucumbers, the melons, the leeks, the onions, and the garlic.

verses.kjv: But now our soul is dried away: there is nothing at all, beside this manna, before our eyes.
verses.modern: But now our strength is dried up, and there is nothing at all but this manna to look at.'

verses.kjv: And the manna was as coriander seed, and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium.
verses.modern: Now the manna was like coriander seed, and its appearance like that of bdellium.

verses.kjv: And the people went about, and gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in a mortar, and baked it in pans, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.
verses.modern: The people went about and gathered it and ground it in hand mills or beat it in mortars and boiled it in pots and made cakes of it. And the taste of it was like the taste of cakes baked with oil.

verses.kjv: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.
verses.modern: When the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell with it.

verses.kjv: Then Moses heard the people weep throughout their families, every man in the door of his tent: and the anger of the LORD was kindled greatly; Moses also was displeased.
verses.modern: Moses heard the people weeping throughout their clans, everyone at the door of his tent. And the anger of the LORD blazed hotly, and Moses was displeased.

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto the LORD, Wherefore hast thou afflicted thy servant? and wherefore have I not found favour in thy sight, that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me?
verses.modern: Moses said to the LORD, 'Why have You dealt ill with Your servant? And why have I not found favor in Your sight, that You lay the burden of all this people on me?

verses.kjv: Have I conceived all this people? have I begotten them, that thou shouldest say unto me, Carry them in thy bosom, as a nursing father beareth the sucking child, unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers?
verses.modern: Did I conceive all this people? Did I give them birth, that You should say to me, "Carry them in Your bosom, as a nurse carries a nursing child," to the land that You swore to give their fathers?

verses.kjv: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.
verses.modern: Where am I to get meat to give to all this people? For they weep before me and say, "Give us meat, that we may eat."

verses.kjv: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.
verses.modern: I am not able to carry all this people alone; the burden is too heavy for me.

verses.kjv: And if thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, if I have found favour in thy sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.
verses.modern: If You will treat me like this, kill me at once, if I find favor in Your sight, that I may not see my wretchedness.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them unto the tabernacle of the congregation, that they may stand there with thee.
verses.modern: Then the LORD said to Moses, 'Gather for me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people and officers over them, and bring them to the tent of meeting, and let them take their stand there with You.

verses.kjv: And I will come down and talk with thee there: and I will take of the spirit which is upon thee, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee, that thou bear it not thyself alone.
verses.modern: I will come down and talk with You there. And I will take some of the Spirit that is on You and put it on them. They shall bear the burden of the people with you, so that you may not bear it yourself alone.

verses.kjv: And say thou unto the people, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow, and ye shall eat flesh: for ye have wept in the ears of the LORD, saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for it was well with us in Egypt: therefore the LORD will give you flesh, and ye shall eat.
verses.modern: say to the people, "Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow, and You shall eat meat, for You have wept in the hearing of the LORD, saying, 'Who will give us meat to eat? For it was better for us in Egypt.' Therefore the LORD will give You meat, and You shall eat.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days;
verses.modern: You shall not eat just one day, or two days, or five days, or ten days, or twenty days,

verses.kjv: But even a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you: because that ye have despised the LORD which is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?
verses.modern: but a whole month, until it comes out at Your nostrils and becomes loathsome to You, because You have rejected the LORD Who is among You and have wept before Him, saying, 'Why did we come out of Egypt?'"'

verses.kjv: And Moses said, The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand footmen; and thou hast said, I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.
verses.modern: But Moses said, 'The people among whom I am number 600,000 on foot, and you have said, "I will give them meat, that they may eat a whole month!"

verses.kjv: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?
verses.modern: Shall flocks and herds be slaughtered for them, and be enough for them? Or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, and be enough for them?'

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Is the LORD's hand waxed short? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.
verses.modern: the LORD said to Moses, 'Is the LORD's hand shortened? Now you shall see whether my word will come true for you or not.'

verses.kjv: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of the LORD, and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the tabernacle.
verses.modern: So Moses went out and told the people the words of the LORD. And He gathered seventy men of the elders of the people and placed them around the tent.

verses.kjv: And the LORD came down in a cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the spirit that was upon him, and gave it unto the seventy elders: and it came to pass, that, when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and did not cease.
verses.modern: Then the LORD came down in the cloud and spoke to Him, and took some of the Spirit that was on Him and put it on the seventy elders. And as soon as the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied. But they did so no more.

verses.kjv: But there remained two of the men in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the spirit rested upon them; and they were of them that were written, but went not out unto the tabernacle: and they prophesied in the camp.
verses.modern: Now two men remained in the camp, one named Eldad, and the other named Medad, and the Spirit rested on them. They were among those registered. But They had not gone out to the tent, and so they prophesied in the camp.

verses.kjv: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.
verses.modern: a young man ran and told Moses, 'Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp.'

verses.kjv: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his young men, answered and said, My lord Moses, forbid them.
verses.modern: Joshua the son of Nun, the assistant of Moses from his youth, said, 'My lord Moses, stop them.'

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto him, Enviest thou for my sake? would God that all the LORD's people were prophets, and that the LORD would put his spirit upon them!
verses.modern: But Moses said to him, 'Are you jealous for my sake? Would that all the LORD's people were prophets, that the LORD would put His Spirit on them!'

verses.kjv: And Moses gat him into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.
verses.modern: Moses and the elders of Israel returned to the camp.

verses.kjv: And there went forth a wind from the LORD, and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, as it were a day's journey on this side, and as it were a day's journey on the other side, round about the camp, and as it were two cubits high upon the face of the earth.
verses.modern: Then a wind from the LORD sprang up and brought quail from the sea and let them fall beside the camp, about a day's journey on this side and a day's journey on the other side, around the camp, and about two cubits above the ground.

verses.kjv: And the people stood up all that day, and all that night, and all the next day, and they gathered the quails: he that gathered least gathered ten homers: and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp.
verses.modern: the people rose all that day and all night and all the next day, and gathered the quail. Those who gathered least gathered ten homers. And they spread them out for themselves all around the camp.

verses.kjv: And while the flesh was yet between their teeth, ere it was chewed, the wrath of the LORD was kindled against the people, and the LORD smote the people with a very great plague.
verses.modern: While the meat was yet between their teeth, before it was consumed, the anger of the LORD was kindled against the people. The LORD struck down the people with a very great plague.

verses.kjv: And he called the name of that place Kibrothhattaavah: because there they buried the people that lusted.
verses.modern: Therefore the name of that place was called Kibroth-hattaavah, because there they buried the people who had the craving.

verses.kjv: And the people journeyed from Kibrothhattaavah unto Hazeroth; and abode at Hazeroth.
verses.modern: From Kibroth-hattaavah the people journeyed to Hazeroth. They remained at Hazeroth.

chapters.summary: The people complain about hardship and the LORD's fire burns the outskirts of the camp. They then weep for meat, remembering the food of Egypt; the LORD sends quail in great abundance but strikes the greedy with a severe plague. Moses appoints seventy elders, and the LORD puts His Spirit upon them.

verses.kjv: And Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married: for he had married an Ethiopian woman.
verses.modern: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married, for he had married an Ethiopian woman.

verses.kjv: And they said, Hath the LORD indeed spoken only by Moses? hath he not spoken also by us? And the LORD heard it.
verses.modern: they said, 'Has the LORD indeed spoken only through Moses? Has he not spoken through us also?' And the LORD heard it.

verses.kjv: (Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.)
verses.modern: Now the man Moses was very meek, more than all people who were on the face of the earth.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake suddenly unto Moses, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam, Come out ye three unto the tabernacle of the congregation. And they three came out.
verses.modern: suddenly the LORD said to Moses and to Aaron and Miriam, 'Come out, you three, to the tent of meeting.' And the three of them came out.

verses.kjv: And the LORD came down in the pillar of the cloud, and stood in the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam: and they both came forth.
verses.modern: the LORD came down in a pillar of cloud and stood at the entrance of the tent and called Aaron and Miriam. They both came forward.

verses.kjv: And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, I the LORD will make myself known unto him in a vision, and will speak unto him in a dream.
verses.modern: he said, 'Hear my words: If there is a prophet among You, I the LORD make myself known to Him in a vision; I speak with Him in a dream.

verses.kjv: My servant Moses is not so, who is faithful in all mine house.
verses.modern: Not so with my servant Moses. He is faithful in all my house.

verses.kjv: With him will I speak mouth to mouth, even apparently, and not in dark speeches; and the similitude of the LORD shall he behold: wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?
verses.modern: With Him I speak mouth to mouth, clearly, and not in riddles. He beholds the form of the LORD. Why then were You not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?'

verses.kjv: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against them; and he departed.
verses.modern: the anger of the LORD was kindled against them. He departed.

verses.kjv: And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle; and, behold, Miriam became leprous, white as snow: and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and, behold, she was leprous.
verses.modern: When the cloud removed from over the tent, Miriam was leprous, like snow. And Aaron turned toward Miriam. She was leprous.

verses.kjv: And Aaron said unto Moses, Alas, my lord, I beseech thee, lay not the sin upon us, wherein we have done foolishly, and wherein we have sinned.
verses.modern: Aaron said to Moses, 'Oh, my lord, do not punish us because we have done foolishly and have sinned.

verses.kjv: Let her not be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother's womb.
verses.modern: Let her not be as one dead, whose flesh is half eaten away when he comes out of his mother's womb.'

verses.kjv: And Moses cried unto the LORD, saying, Heal her now, O God, I beseech thee.
verses.modern: Moses cried to the LORD, 'O God, please heal her — please.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received in again.
verses.modern: But the LORD said to Moses, 'If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be shamed seven days? Let her be shut outside the camp seven days, and after that she may be brought in again.'

verses.kjv: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again.
verses.modern: So Miriam was shut outside the camp seven days, and the people did not set out on the march until Miriam was brought in again.

verses.kjv: And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.modern: After that the people set out from Hazeroth, and camped in the wilderness of Paran.

chapters.summary: Miriam and Aaron speak against Moses because of his Ethiopian wife and challenge his unique authority. The LORD rebukes them, declaring that He speaks with Moses face to face, and strikes Miriam with leprosy; she is shut outside the camp seven days before being healed.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Send thou men, that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a ruler among them.
verses.modern: 'Send men to spy out the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the people of Israel. From each tribe of their fathers You shall send a man, every one a chief among them.'

verses.kjv: And Moses by the commandment of the LORD sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men were heads of the children of Israel.
verses.modern: So Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran, according to the command of the LORD, all of them men who were heads of the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And these were their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.
verses.modern: these were their names: From the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur;

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.
verses.modern: from the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori;

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.modern: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh;

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.
verses.modern: from the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph;

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.
verses.modern: from the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun;

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.
verses.modern: from the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu;

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.
verses.modern: from the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi;

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Joseph, namely, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.
verses.modern: from the tribe of Joseph, that is, from the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi;

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.
verses.modern: from the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli;

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.
verses.modern: from the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael;

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.
verses.modern: from the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi;

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
verses.modern: from the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

verses.kjv: These are the names of the men which Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.
verses.modern: These were the names of the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.

verses.kjv: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way southward, and go up into the mountain:
verses.modern: Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan and said to them, 'Go up this way into the south and go up into the hill country,

verses.kjv: And see the land, what it is; and the people that dwelleth therein, whether they be strong or weak, few or many;
verses.modern: see what the land is, and whether the people who dwell in it are strong or weak, whether they are few or many,

verses.kjv: And what the land is that they dwell in, whether it be good or bad; and what cities they be that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;
verses.modern: whether the land that they dwell in is good or bad, and whether the cities that they dwell in are camps or strongholds,

verses.kjv: And what the land is, whether it be fat or lean, whether there be wood therein, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the firstripe grapes.
verses.modern: whether the land is rich or poor, and whether there are trees in it or not. Be of good courage and bring some of the fruit of the land.' Now the time was the season of the first ripe grapes.

verses.kjv: So they went up, and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, as men come to Hamath.
verses.modern: So they went up and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, as men come to Hamath.

verses.kjv: And they ascended by the south, and came unto Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
verses.modern: They went up into the south, and came to Hebron. Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the descendants of Anak, were there. Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.

verses.kjv: And they came unto the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and they brought of the pomegranates, and of the figs.
verses.modern: they came to the Valley of Eshcol and cut down from there a branch with a single cluster of grapes. They carried it on a pole between two of them; they also brought some pomegranates and figs.

verses.kjv: The place was called the brook Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Israel cut down from thence.
verses.modern: That place was called the Valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster that the people of Israel cut down from there.

verses.kjv: And they returned from searching of the land after forty days.
verses.modern: At the end of forty days they returned from spying out the land.

verses.kjv: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and shewed them the fruit of the land.
verses.modern: they came to Moses and Aaron and to all the congregation of the people of Israel in the wilderness of Paran, at Kadesh. They brought back word to them and to all the congregation, and showed them the fruit of the land.

verses.kjv: And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither thou sentest us, and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.
verses.modern: they told him, 'We came to the land to which you sent us. It flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless the people be strong that dwell in the land, and the cities are walled, and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.
verses.modern: However, the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and very large. And besides, we saw the descendants of Anak there.

verses.kjv: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south: and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, dwell in the mountains: and the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the coast of Jordan.
verses.modern: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south. The Hittites, the Jebusites, and the Amorites dwell in the hill country. And the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and along the Jordan.'

verses.kjv: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.
verses.modern: But Caleb quieted the people before Moses and said, 'Let us go up at once and occupy it, for we are well able to overcome it.'

verses.kjv: But the men that went up with him said, We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.
verses.modern: Then the men who had gone up with him said, 'We are not able to go up against the people, for they are stronger than we are.'

verses.kjv: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched unto the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have gone to search it, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of a great stature.
verses.modern: So they brought to the people of Israel a bad report of the land that they had spied out, saying, 'The land, through which we have gone to spy it out, is a land that devours its inhabitants. All the people that we saw in it are of great height.

verses.kjv: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.
verses.modern: there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, who come from the giants. We seemed to ourselves like grasshoppers, and so we seemed to them.'

chapters.summary: The LORD commands Moses to send twelve spies, one from each tribe, to scout the land of Canaan. After forty days they return with grapes, pomegranates, and figs, but ten of the spies give a fearful report, saying the inhabitants are giants and the land devours its people; only Caleb and Joshua urge Israel to go up.

verses.kjv: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
verses.modern: Then all the congregation raised a loud cry, and the people wept that night.

verses.kjv: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would God we had died in this wilderness!
verses.modern: All the people of Israel grumbled against Moses and Aaron. The whole congregation said to them, 'If only we had died in the land of Egypt! Or if only we had died in this wilderness!

verses.kjv: And wherefore hath the LORD brought us unto this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey? were it not better for us to return into Egypt?
verses.modern: Why is the LORD bringing us into this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will become plunder. Would it not be better for us to go back to Egypt?'

verses.kjv: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.
verses.modern: they said to one another, 'Let us choose a leader and go back to Egypt.'

verses.kjv: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.
verses.modern: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of them that searched the land, rent their clothes:
verses.modern: Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were among those who had spied out the land, tore their clothes

verses.kjv: And they spake unto all the company of the children of Israel, saying, The land, which we passed through to search it, is an exceeding good land.
verses.modern: said to all the congregation of the people of Israel, 'The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an greatly good land.

verses.kjv: If the LORD delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.
verses.modern: If the LORD delights in us, He will bring us into this land and give it to us, a land that flows with milk and honey.

verses.kjv: Only rebel not ye against the LORD, neither fear ye the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defence is departed from them, and the LORD is with us: fear them not.
verses.modern: Only do not rebel against the LORD. And do not fear the people of the land, for they are our prey. Their protection has been removed from them. The LORD is with us. Do not fear them.'

verses.kjv: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones. And the glory of the LORD appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel.
verses.modern: But all the congregation said to stone them with stones. Then the glory of the LORD appeared at the tent of meeting to all the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, How long will this people provoke me? and how long will it be ere they believe me, for all the signs which I have shewed among them?
verses.modern: the LORD said to Moses, 'How long will this people despise me? And how long will they not believe in me, in spite of all the signs that I have done among them?

verses.kjv: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of thee a greater nation and mightier than they.
verses.modern: I will strike them with pestilence and disinherit them. I will make of You a nation greater and mightier than they.'

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto the LORD, Then the Egyptians shall hear it, (for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them;)
verses.modern: But Moses said to the LORD, 'Then the Egyptians will hear of it, for You brought up this people in Your might from among them,

verses.kjv: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land: for they have heard that thou LORD art among this people, that thou LORD art seen face to face, and that thy cloud standeth over them, and that thou goest before them, by day time in a pillar of a cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night.
verses.modern: they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that You, O LORD, are in the midst of this people. For You, O LORD, are seen face to face, and Your cloud stands over them and You go before them, in a pillar of cloud by day and in a pillar of fire by night.

verses.kjv: Now if thou shalt kill all this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,
verses.modern: Now if You kill this people as one man, then the nations who have heard your fame will say,

verses.kjv: Because the LORD was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.
verses.modern: "Because the LORD was not able to bring this people into the land that He swore to give them, He has slaughtered them in the wilderness."

verses.kjv: And now, I beseech thee, let the power of my Lord be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,
verses.modern: now, please let the power of the Lord be great as You have promised, saying,

verses.kjv: The LORD is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.
verses.modern: "The LORD is longsuffering and abounding in mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression. But He will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, to the third and the fourth generation."

verses.kjv: Pardon, I beseech thee, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy mercy, and as thou hast forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.
verses.modern: Please pardon the iniquity of this people, according to the greatness of Your mercy, just as You have forgiven this people, from Egypt until now.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD said, I have pardoned according to thy word:
verses.modern: Then the LORD said, 'I have pardoned, according to Your word.

verses.kjv: But as truly as I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the LORD.
verses.modern: But truly, as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the LORD,

verses.kjv: Because all those men which have seen my glory, and my miracles, which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tempted me now these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice;
verses.modern: none of the men who have seen my glory and my signs that I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and yet have put me to the test these ten times and have not obeyed my voice,

verses.kjv: Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked me see it:
verses.modern: shall see the land that I swore to give to their fathers. None of those who despised me shall see it.

verses.kjv: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.
verses.modern: But my servant Caleb, because he has a different spirit and has followed me fully, I will bring into the land into which he went. His descendants shall possess it.

verses.kjv: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley.) To morrow turn you, and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
verses.modern: Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwell in the valleys. Turn tomorrow and set out for the wilderness by the way of the Red Sea.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

verses.kjv: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, which murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.
verses.modern: 'How long shall this wicked congregation grumble against me? I have heard the grumblings of the people of Israel, which they grumble against me.

verses.kjv: Say unto them, As truly as I live, saith the LORD, as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you:
verses.modern: Say to them, "As I live," declares the LORD, "what You have said in my hearing I will do to You:

verses.kjv: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, which have murmured against me,
verses.modern: your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness, and of all Your number, listed in the census from twenty years old and upward, who have grumbled against me,

verses.kjv: Doubtless ye shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.modern: not one shall come into the land where I swore that I would make you dwell, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh and Joshua the son of Nun.

verses.kjv: But your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have despised.
verses.modern: But your little ones, who you said would become plunder, I will bring in. They shall know the land that you have rejected.

verses.kjv: But as for you, your carcases, they shall fall in this wilderness.
verses.modern: But as for you, your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness.

verses.kjv: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your whoredoms, until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness.
verses.modern: your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years and shall bear your whoredoms, until the last of your dead bodies lies in the wilderness.

verses.kjv: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years, and ye shall know my breach of promise.
verses.modern: According to the number of the days in which you spied out the land, forty days, a year for each day, you shall bear your iniquity forty years, and you shall know my displeasure.

verses.kjv: I the LORD have said, I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.
verses.modern: I, the LORD, have spoken. Surely this will I do to all this wicked congregation who are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall come to a full end, and there they shall die."

verses.kjv: And the men, which Moses sent to search the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up a slander upon the land,
verses.modern: the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned and made all the congregation grumble against him by bringing up a bad report about the land—

verses.kjv: Even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land, died by the plague before the LORD.
verses.modern: those men who brought up a bad report of the land died by plague before the LORD.

verses.kjv: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of the men that went to search the land, lived still.
verses.modern: Of those men who went to spy out the land, only Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh remained alive.

verses.kjv: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.
verses.modern: When Moses told these words to all the people of Israel, the people mourned greatly.

verses.kjv: And they rose up early in the morning, and gat them up into the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we be here, and will go up unto the place which the LORD hath promised: for we have sinned.
verses.modern: they rose early in the morning and went up to the heights of the hill country, saying, 'Here we are. We will go up to the place that the LORD has promised, for we have sinned.'

verses.kjv: And Moses said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the LORD? but it shall not prosper.
verses.modern: But Moses said, 'Why are you transgressing the command of the LORD? For that will not succeed.

verses.kjv: Go not up, for the LORD is not among you; that ye be not smitten before your enemies.
verses.modern: Do not go up, for the LORD is not among You, lest You be struck down before Your enemies.

verses.kjv: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and ye shall fall by the sword: because ye are turned away from the LORD, therefore the LORD will not be with you.
verses.modern: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before You, and You shall fall by the sword. Because You have turned back from the LORD, the LORD will not be with You.'

verses.kjv: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and Moses, departed not out of the camp.
verses.modern: But they presumed to go up to the heights of the hill country, even though the ark of the covenant of the LORD and Moses did not depart out of the camp.

verses.kjv: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill, and smote them, and discomfited them, even unto Hormah.
verses.modern: Then the Amalekites and the Canaanites who lived in that hill country came down and defeated them, pursuing them to Hormah.

chapters.summary: The people weep, rebel, and threaten to choose a new leader to return to Egypt. The LORD threatens to destroy them, but Moses intercedes; God pardons the nation but decrees that the entire adult generation except Caleb and Joshua will die in the wilderness over forty years. The people then presumptuously try to invade Canaan and are defeated.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you,
verses.modern: 'Speak to the people of Israel and say to them, when you come into the land You are to inhabit, which I am giving You,

verses.kjv: And will make an offering by fire unto the LORD, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or in a freewill offering, or in your solemn feasts, to make a sweet savour unto the LORD, of the herd, or of the flock:
verses.modern: you offer to the LORD a offering made by fire from the herd or from the flock — whether a burnt offering or a sacrifice, to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering or at Your appointed feasts — to make a sweet savour unto the LORD,

verses.kjv: Then shall he that offereth his offering unto the LORD bring a meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of oil.
verses.modern: then He who brings his offering shall offer to the LORD a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of fine flour, mixed with a quarter of a hin of oil;

verses.kjv: And the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice, for one lamb.
verses.modern: you shall offer with the burnt offering, or for the sacrifice, a quarter of a hin of wine as a drink offering for each lamb.

verses.kjv: Or for a ram, thou shalt prepare for a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third part of an hin of oil.
verses.modern: Or for a ram, You shall offer a grain offering of two tenths of an ephah of fine flour, mixed with a third of a hin of oil.

verses.kjv: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third part of an hin of wine, for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.modern: for a drink offering You shall offer a third of a hin of wine, a sweet savour unto the LORD.

verses.kjv: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings unto the LORD:
verses.modern: when You offer a bull as a burnt offering or sacrifice, to fulfill a vow or for peace offerings to the LORD,

verses.kjv: Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil.
verses.modern: then You shall offer with the bull a grain offering of three tenths of an ephah of fine flour, mixed with half a hin of oil.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.modern: you shall offer for the drink offering half a hin of wine, as a offering made by fire, a sweet savour unto the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.
verses.modern: Thus it shall be done for each bull or ram, or for each of the male lambs or the young goats.

verses.kjv: According to the number that ye shall prepare, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.
verses.modern: According to the number that You offer, so shall You do for each one, according to their number.

verses.kjv: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.modern: Every native Israelite shall do these things in this way, in offering a offering made by fire, a sweet savour unto the LORD.

verses.kjv: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever be among you in your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD; as ye do, so he shall do.
verses.modern: if a stranger is sojourning with You, or anyone is living among you throughout your generations. He wishes to offer a offering made by fire, a sweet savour unto the LORD, He shall do as You do.

verses.kjv: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation, and also for the stranger that sojourneth with you, an ordinance for ever in your generations: as ye are, so shall the stranger be before the LORD.
verses.modern: For the assembly, there shall be one statute for You and for the stranger who sojourns with You, a statute forever throughout Your generations. You and the sojourner shall be alike before the LORD.

verses.kjv: One law and one manner shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.
verses.modern: One law and one rule shall be for You and for the stranger who sojourns with You.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land whither I bring you,
verses.modern: 'Speak to the people of Israel and say to them, when you come into the land to which I am bringing You

verses.kjv: Then it shall be, that, when ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall offer up an heave offering unto the LORD.
verses.modern: when You eat of the bread of the land, You shall present a contribution to the LORD.

verses.kjv: Ye shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough for an heave offering: as ye do the heave offering of the threshingfloor, so shall ye heave it.
verses.modern: Of the first of Your dough You shall present a loaf as a contribution; like a contribution from the threshing floor, so shall You present it.

verses.kjv: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the LORD an heave offering in your generations.
verses.modern: Some of the first of Your dough You shall give to the LORD as a contribution throughout Your generations.

verses.kjv: And if ye have erred, and not observed all these commandments, which the LORD hath spoken unto Moses,
verses.modern: But if You sin unintentionally, and do not observe all these commandments that the LORD has spoken to Moses—

verses.kjv: Even all that the LORD hath commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that the LORD commanded Moses, and henceforward among your generations;
verses.modern: all that the LORD has commanded You by Moses, from the day that the LORD gave commandment, and onward throughout Your generations—

verses.kjv: Then it shall be, if ought be committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour unto the LORD, with his meat offering, and his drink offering, according to the manner, and one kid of the goats for a sin offering.
verses.modern: then if it was done unintentionally without the knowledge of the congregation, all the congregation shall offer one bull from the herd for a burnt offering, a sweet savour unto the LORD, with its grain offering and its drink offering, according to the rule, and one male goat for a sin offering.
