verses.modern: the priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the people of Israel. They shall be forgiven, because it was a mistake. They have brought their offering, a offering made by fire to the LORD. Their sin offering before the LORD for their mistake.

verses.kjv: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Israel, and the stranger that sojourneth among them; seeing all the people were in ignorance.
verses.modern: all the congregation of the people of Israel shall be forgiven, and the stranger who sojourns among them, because the whole population was involved in the mistake.

verses.kjv: And if any soul sin through ignorance, then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering.
verses.modern: If one person sins unintentionally, He shall offer a female goat a year old for a sin offering.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly, when he sinneth by ignorance before the LORD, to make an atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.modern: the priest shall make atonement before the LORD for the person who makes a mistake, when He sins unintentionally, to make atonement for Him. He shall be forgiven.

verses.kjv: Ye shall have one law for him that sinneth through ignorance, both for him that is born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them.
verses.modern: You shall have one law for Him who does anything unintentionally, for Him who is native among the people of Israel and for the stranger who sojourns among them.

verses.kjv: But the soul that doeth ought presumptuously, whether he be born in the land, or a stranger, the same reproacheth the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.modern: But the person who does anything with a high hand, whether He is native or a stranger, reviles the LORD, and that person shall be cut off from among His people.

verses.kjv: Because he hath despised the word of the LORD, and hath broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be upon him.
verses.modern: Because He has despised the word of the LORD and has broken His commandment, that person shall be utterly cut off; His iniquity shall be on Him.'

verses.kjv: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man that gathered sticks upon the sabbath day.
verses.modern: While the people of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.

verses.modern: those who found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron and to all the congregation.

verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.modern: it shall be a tassel for You to look at and remember all the commandments of the LORD, to do them, not to follow after Your own heart and Your own eyes, which You are inclined to pursue after in unfaithfulness.

chapters.summary: The LORD gives additional laws concerning grain and drink offerings that must accompany animal sacrifices in the Promised Land. He commands the wearing of fringes with a blue cord on their garments as a reminder to keep His commandments, and a man found gathering sticks on the Sabbath is stoned to death by the congregation.

verses.kjv: So they gat up from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood in the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little children.
verses.modern: So they moved away from the dwelling of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side. And Dathan and Abiram came out and stood at the door of their tents, together with their wives, their sons. Their little children.

verses.kjv: And Moses said, Hereby ye shall know that the LORD hath sent me to do all these works; for I have not done them of mine own mind.
verses.modern: Moses said, 'By this you shall know that the LORD has sent me to do all these works, and that it has not been of my own accord.

verses.kjv: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then the LORD hath not sent me.
verses.modern: If these men die as all men die, or if they are visited by the fate of all mankind, then the LORD has not sent me.

verses.kjv: But if the LORD make a new thing, and the earth open her mouth, and swallow them up, with all that appertain unto them, and they go down quick into the pit; then ye shall understand that these men have provoked the LORD.
verses.modern: But if the LORD does something unprecedented, and the ground opens its mouth and swallows them up with all that belongs to them. They go down alive into the pit, then You shall know that these men have despised the LORD.'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as he had made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground clave asunder that was under them:
verses.modern: as soon as He had finished speaking all these words, the ground under them split apart.

verses.kjv: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their houses, and all the men that appertained unto Korah, and all their goods.
verses.modern: the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, with their households and all the people who belonged to Korah and all their goods.

verses.kjv: They, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into the pit, and the earth closed upon them: and they perished from among the congregation.
verses.modern: So they and all that belonged to them went down alive into the pit, and the earth closed over them. They perished from the midst of the assembly.

verses.kjv: And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them: for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up also.
verses.modern: all Israel who were around them fled at their cry, for they said, 'Lest the earth swallow us up too!'

verses.kjv: And there came out a fire from the LORD, and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense.
verses.modern: fire came out from the LORD and consumed the 250 men offering the incense.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter thou the fire yonder; for they are hallowed.
verses.modern: 'Tell Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest to take up the censers out of the blaze. Then scatter the fire far and wide, for they have become holy —

verses.kjv: The censers of these sinners against their own souls, let them be made broad plates for a covering of the altar: for they offered them before the LORD, therefore they are hallowed: and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel.
verses.modern: the censers of these men who sinned at the cost of their lives. Let them be hammered into flat plates as a covering for the altar, for they offered them before the LORD. They have become holy. Thus they shall be a sign to the people of Israel.'

verses.kjv: And Eleazar the priest took the brasen censers, wherewith they that were burnt had offered; and they were made broad plates for a covering of the altar:
verses.modern: So Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers, which those who were burned had offered. They were hammered out as a covering for the altar,

verses.kjv: To be a memorial unto the children of Israel, that no stranger, which is not of the seed of Aaron, come near to offer incense before the LORD; that he be not as Korah, and as his company: as the LORD said to him by the hand of Moses.
verses.modern: to be a reminder to the people of Israel, so that no outsider, who is not of the descendants of Aaron, should draw near to offer incense before the LORD, lest He become like Korah and His company — as the LORD said to Him through Moses.

verses.kjv: But on the morrow all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, Ye have killed the people of the LORD.
verses.modern: But on the next day all the congregation of the people of Israel grumbled against Moses and against Aaron, saying, 'You have killed the people of the LORD.'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when the congregation was gathered against Moses and against Aaron, that they looked toward the tabernacle of the congregation: and, behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of the LORD appeared.
verses.modern: when the congregation had assembled against Moses and against Aaron, they turned toward the tent of meeting. And the cloud covered it, and the glory of the LORD appeared.

verses.kjv: And Moses and Aaron came before the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.modern: Moses and Aaron came to the front of the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Get you up from among this congregation, that I may consume them as in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.
verses.modern: 'Get away from the midst of this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.' And they fell on their faces.

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a censer, and put fire therein from off the altar, and put on incense, and go quickly unto the congregation, and make an atonement for them: for there is wrath gone out from the LORD; the plague is begun.
verses.modern: Moses said to Aaron, 'Take your censer, and put fire on it from off the altar and lay incense on it and carry it quickly to the congregation and make atonement for them, for wrath has gone out from the LORD; the plague has begun.'

verses.kjv: And Aaron took as Moses commanded, and ran into the midst of the congregation; and, behold, the plague was begun among the people: and he put on incense, and made an atonement for the people.
verses.modern: So Aaron took it as Moses said and ran into the midst of the assembly. And the plague had already begun among the people. And he put on the incense and made atonement for the people.

verses.kjv: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.
verses.modern: He stood between the dead and the living, and the plague was stopped.

verses.kjv: Now they that died in the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, beside them that died about the matter of Korah.
verses.modern: Now those who died in the plague were 14,700, besides those who died in the affair of Korah.

verses.kjv: And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the plague was stayed.
verses.modern: Aaron returned to Moses at the entrance of the tent of meeting, when the plague had been stopped.

chapters.summary: Korah, Dathan, and Abiram lead a rebellion of 250 leaders against the authority of Moses and Aaron. The LORD causes the earth to open and swallow Korah's company alive, and fire from the LORD consumes the 250 men offering incense. The next day the congregation grumbles again, and a plague kills 14,700 before Aaron makes atonement.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and take of every one of them a rod according to the house of their fathers, of all their princes according to the house of their fathers twelve rods: write thou every man's name upon his rod.
verses.modern: 'Speak to the people of Israel, and get from them a staff for each fathers' house, from all their chiefs according to their fathers' houses — twelve staffs. Write each man's name on his staff.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt write Aaron's name upon the rod of Levi: for one rod shall be for the head of the house of their fathers.
verses.modern: write Aaron's name on the staff of Levi. For there shall be one staff for the head of each fathers' house.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt lay them up in the tabernacle of the congregation before the testimony, where I will meet with you.
verses.modern: Then you shall deposit them in the tent of meeting before the testimony, where I meet with you.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that the man's rod, whom I shall choose, shall blossom: and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel, whereby they murmur against you.
verses.modern: the staff of the man whom I choose shall sprout. Thus I will make to cease from me the grumblings of the people of Israel, which they grumble against you.'

verses.kjv: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, and every one of their princes gave him a rod apiece, for each prince one, according to their fathers' houses, even twelve rods: and the rod of Aaron was among their rods.
verses.modern: Moses spoke to the people of Israel. And all their chiefs gave him staffs, one for each chief, according to their fathers' houses — twelve staffs. And the staff of Aaron was among their staffs.

verses.kjv: And Moses laid up the rods before the LORD in the tabernacle of witness.
verses.modern: Moses deposited the staffs before the LORD in the tent of the testimony.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that on the morrow Moses went into the tabernacle of witness; and, behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms, and yielded almonds.
verses.modern: On the next day Moses went into the tent of the testimony, and the staff of Aaron for the house of Levi had sprouted and put forth buds and produced blossoms. It bore ripe almonds.

verses.kjv: And Moses brought out all the rods from before the LORD unto all the children of Israel: and they looked, and took every man his rod.
verses.modern: Then Moses brought out all the staffs from before the LORD to all the people of Israel. And they looked, and each man took his staff.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Bring Aaron's rod again before the testimony, to be kept for a token against the rebels; and thou shalt quite take away their murmurings from me, that they die not.
verses.modern: the LORD said to Moses, 'Put back the staff of Aaron before the testimony, to be kept as a sign for the rebels, that you may make an end of their grumblings against me, lest they die.'

verses.kjv: And Moses did so: as the LORD commanded him, so did he.
verses.modern: Moses did so; as the LORD commanded Him, so He did.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel spake unto Moses, saying, Behold, we die, we perish, we all perish.
verses.modern: the people of Israel said to Moses, 'We are perishing, we are all perishing.

verses.kjv: Whosoever cometh any thing near unto the tabernacle of the LORD shall die: shall we be consumed with dying?
verses.modern: Everyone who comes near, who comes near to the tabernacle of the LORD, dies. Are we all to perish?'

chapters.summary: The LORD commands that twelve staffs, one for each tribal leader, be placed in the tent of meeting to settle the dispute over the priesthood. Aaron's staff for the tribe of Levi sprouts, buds, blossoms, and produces ripe almonds overnight, confirming his chosen priesthood.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Aaron, Thou and thy sons and thy father's house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary: and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.
verses.modern: The LORD said to Aaron, 'You and your sons and your father's house with you shall bear iniquity of the sanctuary, and you and your sons with You shall bear iniquity of Your priesthood.

verses.kjv: And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi, the tribe of thy father, bring thou with thee, that they may be joined unto thee, and minister unto thee: but thou and thy sons with thee shall minister before the tabernacle of witness.
verses.modern: bring Your brothers also, the tribe of Levi, the tribe of Your father, that they may join You and minister to You while You and Your sons with You are before the tent of the testimony.

verses.kjv: And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of all the tabernacle: only they shall not come nigh the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, that neither they, nor ye also, die.
verses.modern: They shall keep guard over You and over the whole tent. But They shall not come near to the vessels of the sanctuary or to the altar lest they, and You, die.

verses.kjv: And they shall be joined unto thee, and keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, for all the service of the tabernacle: and a stranger shall not come nigh unto you.
verses.modern: They shall join You and keep guard over the tent of meeting for all the service of the tent, and no outsider shall come near You.

verses.kjv: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar: that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Israel.
verses.modern: you shall keep guard over the sanctuary and over the altar, that there may never again be wrath on the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And I, behold, I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel: to you they are given as a gift for the LORD, to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.modern: I have taken Your brothers the Levites from among the people of Israel. They are a gift to you, given to the LORD, to do the service of the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: Therefore thou and thy sons with thee shall keep your priest's office for every thing of the altar, and within the veil; and ye shall serve: I have given your priest's office unto you as a service of gift: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.modern: you and Your sons with You shall guard Your priesthood for all that concerns the altar and that is within the veil. You shall serve. I give Your priesthood as a gift, and any outsider who comes near shall be put to death.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Behold, I also have given thee the charge of mine heave offerings of all the hallowed things of the children of Israel; unto thee have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to thy sons, by an ordinance for ever.
verses.modern: Then the LORD spoke to Aaron, ' I have given you charge of the contributions made to me, all the consecrated things of the people of Israel. I have given them to you as a portion and to Your sons as a perpetual due.

verses.kjv: This shall be thine of the most holy things, reserved from the fire: every oblation of theirs, every meat offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall render unto me, shall be most holy for thee and for thy sons.
verses.modern: This shall be Yours of the most holy things, reserved from the fire: every offering of theirs, every grain offering of theirs, every sin offering of theirs, and every guilt offering of theirs, which they render to me, shall be most holy for You and for Your sons.

verses.kjv: In the most holy place shalt thou eat it; every male shall eat it: it shall be holy unto thee.
verses.modern: In a most holy place You shall eat it. Every male may eat it; it is holy to You.

verses.kjv: And this is thine; the heave offering of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the children of Israel: I have given them unto thee, and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it.
verses.modern: This also is Yours: the contribution of their gift, all the wave offerings of the people of Israel. I have given them to you, and to Your sons and daughters with You, as a perpetual due. Everyone who is clean in Your house may eat it.

verses.kjv: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the wine, and of the wheat, the firstfruits of them which they shall offer unto the LORD, them have I given thee.
verses.modern: All the best of the oil and all the best of the wine and of the grain, the firstfruits of what they give to the LORD, I give to You.

verses.kjv: And whatsoever is first ripe in the land, which they shall bring unto the LORD, shall be thine; every one that is clean in thine house shall eat of it.
verses.modern: The first ripe fruits of all that is in their land, which they bring to the LORD, shall be Yours. Everyone who is clean in Your house may eat it.

verses.kjv: Every thing devoted in Israel shall be thine.
verses.modern: Every devoted thing in Israel shall be Yours.

verses.kjv: Every thing that openeth the matrix in all flesh, which they bring unto the LORD, whether it be of men or beasts, shall be thine: nevertheless the firstborn of man shalt thou surely redeem, and the firstling of unclean beasts shalt thou redeem.
verses.modern: Everything that opens the womb of all flesh, which they offer to the LORD, whether human or animal, shall be Yours. Nevertheless, the firstborn of man You shall redeem, and the firstborn of unclean animals You shall redeem.

verses.kjv: And those that are to be redeemed from a month old shalt thou redeem, according to thine estimation, for the money of five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, which is twenty gerahs.
verses.modern: their redemption price, at a month old You shall redeem them, shall be five shekels in silver, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, which is twenty gerahs.

verses.kjv: But the firstling of a cow, or the firstling of a sheep, or the firstling of a goat, thou shalt not redeem; they are holy: thou shalt sprinkle their blood upon the altar, and shalt burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.modern: But the firstborn of a cow, or the firstborn of a sheep, or the firstborn of a goat, You shall not redeem; they are holy. You shall sprinkle their blood on the altar and shall burn their fat as a offering made by fire, a sweet savour unto the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the flesh of them shall be thine, as the wave breast and as the right shoulder are thine.
verses.modern: But their flesh shall be Yours, as the breast that is waved and as the right thigh are Yours.

verses.kjv: All the heave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer unto the LORD, have I given thee, and thy sons and thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: it is a covenant of salt for ever before the LORD unto thee and to thy seed with thee.
verses.modern: All the contributions of the holy things that the people of Israel present to the LORD I give to You and to Your sons and daughters with You, as a perpetual due. It is a covenant of salt forever before the LORD for You and for Your seed with You.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land, neither shalt thou have any part among them: I am thy part and thine inheritance among the children of Israel.
verses.modern: the LORD said to Aaron, 'You shall have no inheritance in their land, neither shall you have any portion among them. I am your portion and Your inheritance among the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And, behold, I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Israel for an inheritance, for their service which they serve, even the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.modern: To the Levites I have given every tithe in Israel for an inheritance, in return for their service that they do, their service in the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: Neither must the children of Israel henceforth come nigh the tabernacle of the congregation, lest they bear sin, and die.
verses.modern: from now on the people of Israel shall not come near the tent of meeting, lest they bear sin and die.

verses.kjv: But the Levites shall do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they shall bear their iniquity: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations, that among the children of Israel they have no inheritance.
verses.modern: But the Levites shall do the service of the tent of meeting. They shall bear their iniquity. It shall be a perpetual statute throughout Your generations, and among the people of Israel they shall have no inheritance.

verses.kjv: But the tithes of the children of Israel, which they offer as an heave offering unto the LORD, I have given to the Levites to inherit: therefore I have said unto them, Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.
verses.modern: For the tithe of the people of Israel, which they present as a contribution to the LORD, I have given to the Levites for an inheritance. Therefore I have said of them that they shall have no inheritance among the people of Israel.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Thus speak unto the Levites, and say unto them, When ye take of the children of Israel the tithes which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then ye shall offer up an heave offering of it for the LORD, even a tenth part of the tithe.
verses.modern: 'Speak to the Levites and say to them, when You take from the people of Israel the tithe that I have given you from them for Your inheritance, then You shall present a contribution from it to the LORD, a tithe of the tithe.

verses.kjv: And this your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you, as though it were the corn of the threshingfloor, and as the fulness of the winepress.
verses.modern: your contribution shall be counted to You as though it were the grain of the threshing floor and as the fullness of the winepress.

verses.kjv: Thus ye also shall offer an heave offering unto the LORD of all your tithes, which ye receive of the children of Israel; and ye shall give thereof the LORD's heave offering to Aaron the priest.
verses.modern: So You shall also present a contribution to the LORD from all Your tithes, which You receive from the people of Israel. And from it you shall give the LORD's contribution to Aaron the priest.

verses.kjv: Out of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave offering of the LORD, of all the best thereof, even the hallowed part thereof out of it.
verses.modern: Out of all the gifts to You, You shall present every contribution due to the LORD; from each its best part is to be dedicated.'

verses.kjv: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, When ye have heaved the best thereof from it, then it shall be counted unto the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor, and as the increase of the winepress.
verses.modern: So You shall say to them, 'When You have offered from it the best of it, then the rest shall be counted to the Levites as produce of the threshing floor, and as produce of the winepress.

verses.kjv: And ye shall eat it in every place, ye and your households: for it is your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.modern: you may eat it in any place, You and Your households, for it is Your reward in return for Your service in the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it, when ye have heaved from it the best of it: neither shall ye pollute the holy things of the children of Israel, lest ye die.
verses.modern: you shall bear no sin by reason of it, when You have contributed the best of it. But You shall not profane the holy things of the people of Israel, lest you die.'

chapters.summary: The LORD tells Aaron that he and his sons shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary and the priesthood. The Levites are given to serve Aaron, and the priests receive the firstfruits, firstborn offerings, and portions of the sacrifices; the Levites receive all the tithes in Israel as their inheritance, and they in turn tithe to the priests.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

verses.kjv: This is the ordinance of the law which the LORD hath commanded, saying, Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring thee a red heifer without spot, wherein is no blemish, and upon which never came yoke:
verses.modern: 'This is the statute of the law that the LORD has commanded: Tell the people of Israel to bring you a red heifer without defect, in which there is no blemish, and on which a yoke has never come.

verses.kjv: And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest, that he may bring her forth without the camp, and one shall slay her before his face:
verses.modern: you shall give it to Eleazar the priest. It shall be taken outside the camp and slaughtered before him.

verses.kjv: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times:
verses.modern: Eleazar the priest shall take some of its blood with his finger and sprinkle some of its blood toward the front of the tent of meeting seven times.

verses.kjv: And one shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:
verses.modern: the heifer shall be burned in his sight. Its skin, its flesh, and its blood, with its dung, shall be burned.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.
verses.modern: the priest shall take cedarwood and hyssop and scarlet yarn, and throw them into the midst of the burning of the heifer.

verses.kjv: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the even.
verses.modern: Then the priest shall wash his clothes and bathe his body in water, and afterward he may come into the camp. But the priest shall be unclean until evening.

verses.kjv: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.
verses.modern: The one who burns the heifer shall wash his clothes in water and bathe his body in water and shall be unclean until evening.

verses.kjv: And a man that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up without the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water of separation: it is a purification for sin.
verses.modern: a man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer and deposit them outside the camp in a clean place. And they shall be kept for the water for impurity for the congregation of the people of Israel; it is a purification offering.

verses.kjv: And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: and it shall be unto the children of Israel, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them, for a statute for ever.
verses.modern: the one who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes and be unclean until evening. And this shall be a perpetual statute for the people of Israel, and for the stranger who sojourns among them.

verses.kjv: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.
verses.modern: Whoever touches the dead body of any person shall be unclean seven days.

verses.kjv: He shall purify himself with it on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean: but if he purify not himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.
verses.modern: He shall cleanse himself with the water on the third day and on the seventh day, and so be clean. But if he does not cleanse himself on the third day and on the seventh day, he will not become clean.

verses.kjv: Whosoever toucheth the dead body of any man that is dead, and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel: because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.
verses.modern: Whoever touches a dead person, the body of any human being who has died, and does not cleanse Himself, defiles the tabernacle of the LORD, and that person shall be cut off from Israel. Because the water for impurity was not thrown on Him, He shall be unclean. His uncleanness is still on Him.

verses.kjv: This is the law, when a man dieth in a tent: all that come into the tent, and all that is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.
verses.modern: This is the law when someone dies in a tent: everyone who comes into the tent and everyone who is in the tent shall be unclean seven days.

verses.kjv: And every open vessel, which hath no covering bound upon it, is unclean.
verses.modern: every open vessel that has no cover fastened on it is unclean.

verses.kjv: And whosoever toucheth one that is slain with a sword in the open fields, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
verses.modern: Whoever in the open field touches someone who was killed with a sword or who died naturally, or touches a human bone or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.

verses.kjv: And for an unclean person they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin, and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:
verses.modern: For the unclean they shall take some ashes of the burnt purification offering, and fresh water shall be added to them in a vessel.

verses.kjv: And a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched a bone, or one slain, or one dead, or a grave:
verses.modern: Then a clean person shall take hyssop and dip it in the water and sprinkle it on the tent and on all the furnishings and on the persons who were there and on whoever touched the bone, or the slain or the dead or the grave.

verses.kjv: And the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, and wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.
verses.modern: the clean person shall sprinkle it on the unclean on the third day and on the seventh day. Thus on the seventh day He shall cleanse Him. He shall wash His clothes and bathe Himself in water, and at evening He shall be clean.

verses.kjv: But the man that shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation, because he hath defiled the sanctuary of the LORD: the water of separation hath not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean.
verses.modern: But the man who is unclean and does not cleanse himself, that person shall be cut off from the midst of the assembly, since He has defiled the sanctuary of the LORD. Because the water for impurity has not been thrown on Him, He is unclean.

verses.kjv: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them, that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes; and he that toucheth the water of separation shall be unclean until even.
verses.modern: it shall be a perpetual statute for them. The one who sprinkles the water for impurity shall wash His clothes, and the one who touches the water for impurity shall be unclean until evening.

verses.kjv: And whatsoever the unclean person toucheth shall be unclean; and the soul that toucheth it shall be unclean until even.
verses.modern: whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean, and anyone who touches it shall be unclean until evening.'

chapters.summary: The LORD gives the law of the red heifer: a perfect, unblemished red cow is slaughtered and burned outside the camp, and its ashes are mixed with water to create the water of purification. Anyone who touches a dead body is unclean seven days and must be sprinkled with this water on the third and seventh day.

verses.kjv: Then came the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, into the desert of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.
verses.modern: Then the whole congregation of the people of Israel came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month, and the people stayed in Kadesh. And Miriam died there and was buried there.

verses.kjv: And there was no water for the congregation: and they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.
verses.modern: Now there was no water for the congregation. And they assembled themselves against Moses and against Aaron.

verses.kjv: And the people chode with Moses, and spake, saying, Would God that we had died when our brethren died before the LORD!
verses.modern: the people quarreled with Moses and said, 'If only we had perished when our brothers perished before the LORD!

verses.kjv: And why have ye brought up the congregation of the LORD into this wilderness, that we and our cattle should die there?
verses.modern: Why have You brought the assembly of the LORD into this wilderness, that we should die here, both we and our livestock?

verses.kjv: And wherefore have ye made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in unto this evil place? it is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.
verses.modern: why have You made us come up out of Egypt to bring us to this evil place? It is no place for grain or figs or vines or pomegranates, and there is no water to drink.'

verses.kjv: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they fell upon their faces: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto them.
verses.modern: Then Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the entrance of the tent of meeting and fell on their faces. And the glory of the LORD appeared to them.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Take the rod, and gather thou the assembly together, thou, and Aaron thy brother, and speak ye unto the rock before their eyes; and it shall give forth his water, and thou shalt bring forth to them water out of the rock: so thou shalt give the congregation and their beasts drink.
verses.modern: 'Take the staff, and assemble the congregation, you and Aaron your brother, and tell the rock before their eyes to yield its water. So you shall bring water out of the rock for them and give drink to the congregation and their livestock.'

verses.kjv: And Moses took the rod from before the LORD, as he commanded him.
verses.modern: Moses took the staff from before the LORD, as He commanded Him.

verses.kjv: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock, and he said unto them, Hear now, ye rebels; must we fetch you water out of this rock?
verses.modern: Then Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly together before the rock. He said to them, 'Hear now, you rebels: shall we bring water for you out of this rock?'

verses.kjv: And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock twice: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts also.
verses.modern: Moses lifted up his hand and struck the rock with his staff twice, and water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank. and their livestock also.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron, Because ye believed me not, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them.
verses.modern: the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, 'Because you did not believe in me, to uphold me as holy in the eyes of the people of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land that I have given them.'

verses.kjv: This is the water of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with the LORD, and he was sanctified in them.
verses.modern: These are the waters of Meribah, where the people of Israel quarreled with the LORD, and through them He showed Himself holy.

verses.kjv: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh unto the king of Edom, Thus saith thy brother Israel, Thou knowest all the travel that hath befallen us:
verses.modern: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom: 'Thus says your brother Israel: You know all the hardship that has come upon us—

verses.kjv: How our fathers went down into Egypt, and we have dwelt in Egypt a long time; and the Egyptians vexed us, and our fathers:
verses.modern: how our fathers went down to Egypt. We lived in Egypt a long time, and the Egyptians dealt harshly with us and our fathers.

verses.kjv: And when we cried unto the LORD, he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and hath brought us forth out of Egypt: and, behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the uttermost of thy border:
verses.modern: when we cried to the LORD, He heard our voice and sent an angel and brought us out of Egypt. And now we are in Kadesh, a city on the edge of Your territory.

verses.kjv: Let us pass, I pray thee, through thy country: we will not pass through the fields, or through the vineyards, neither will we drink of the water of the wells: we will go by the king's high way, we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed thy borders.
verses.modern: Please let us pass through your land. We will not pass through field or vineyard, or drink water from a well. We will go along the King's Highway. We will not turn aside to the right hand or to the left until we have passed through your territory.'

verses.kjv: And Edom said unto him, Thou shalt not pass by me, lest I come out against thee with the sword.
verses.modern: But Edom said to him, 'You shall not pass through, lest I come out with the sword against you.'

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel said unto him, We will go by the high way: and if I and my cattle drink of thy water, then I will pay for it: I will only, without doing any thing else, go through on my feet.
verses.modern: the people of Israel said to him, 'We will go up by the highway, and if we drink of your water, we and our livestock, then we will pay for it. Let us only pass through on foot — nothing more.'

verses.kjv: And he said, Thou shalt not go through. And Edom came out against him with much people, and with a strong hand.
verses.modern: But he said, 'You shall not pass through.' And Edom came out against them with a large army and with a strong force.

verses.kjv: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border: wherefore Israel turned away from him.
verses.modern: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his territory, so Israel turned away from him.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh, and came unto mount Hor.
verses.modern: they journeyed from Kadesh, and the people of Israel, the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron in mount Hor, by the coast of the land of Edom, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD said to Moses and Aaron at Mount Hor, on the border of the land of Edom,

verses.kjv: Aaron shall be gathered unto his people: for he shall not enter into the land which I have given unto the children of Israel, because ye rebelled against my word at the water of Meribah.
verses.modern: 'Let Aaron be gathered to his people, for he shall not enter the land that I have given to the people of Israel, because you rebelled against my command at the waters of Meribah.

verses.kjv: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up unto mount Hor:
verses.modern: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son and bring them up to Mount Hor.

verses.kjv: And strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be gathered unto his people, and shall die there.
verses.modern: strip Aaron of his garments and put them on Eleazar his son. And Aaron shall be gathered to his people and shall die there.'

verses.kjv: And Moses did as the LORD commanded: and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
verses.modern: Moses did as the LORD commanded. They went up Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.

verses.kjv: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there in the top of the mount: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount.
verses.modern: Moses stripped Aaron of his garments and put them on Eleazar his son. And Aaron died there on the top of the mountain. Then Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.

verses.kjv: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they mourned for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.
verses.modern: when all the congregation saw that Aaron had died, all the house of Israel wept for Aaron thirty days.

chapters.summary: The congregation arrives at Kadesh, where Miriam dies. The people quarrel over the lack of water, and the LORD tells Moses to speak to the rock; instead Moses strikes it twice and is forbidden from entering the Promised Land. Edom refuses Israel passage, and Aaron dies on Mount Hor, where Eleazar succeeds him as priest.

verses.kjv: And when king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south, heard tell that Israel came by the way of the spies; then he fought against Israel, and took some of them prisoners.
verses.modern: When the Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the south, heard that Israel was coming by the way of the spies, he fought against Israel and took some of them captive.

verses.kjv: And Israel vowed a vow unto the LORD, and said, If thou wilt indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.
verses.modern: Israel vowed a vow to the LORD and said, 'If You will indeed give this people into my hand, then I will devote their cities to destruction.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD hearkened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and he called the name of the place Hormah.
verses.modern: the LORD heeded the voice of Israel and gave over the Canaanites. They devoted them and their cities to destruction. So the name of the place was called Hormah.

verses.kjv: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea, to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way.
verses.modern: From Mount Hor they set out by the way to the Red Sea, to go around the land of Edom. And the people became impatient on the way.

verses.kjv: And the people spake against God, and against Moses, Wherefore have ye brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? for there is no bread, neither is there any water; and our soul loatheth this light bread.
verses.modern: the people spoke against God and against Moses, 'Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? For there is no food and no water. We detest this worthless food.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died.
verses.modern: Then the LORD sent fiery serpents among the people. They bit the people, so that many people of Israel died.

verses.kjv: Therefore the people came to Moses, and said, We have sinned, for we have spoken against the LORD, and against thee; pray unto the LORD, that he take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people.
verses.modern: the people came to Moses and said, 'We have sinned, for we have spoken against the LORD and against You. Pray to the LORD, that He take away the serpents from us.' So Moses prayed for the people.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looketh upon it, shall live.
verses.modern: the LORD said to Moses, 'Make a fiery serpent and set it on a pole, and everyone who is bitten, when He sees it, shall live.'

verses.kjv: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.
verses.modern: So Moses made a bronze serpent and set it on a pole. And if a serpent bit anyone, he would look at the bronze serpent and live.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in Oboth.
verses.modern: the people of Israel set out and camped in Oboth.

verses.kjv: And they journeyed from Oboth, and pitched at Ijeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrising.
verses.modern: they set out from Oboth and camped at Iye-abarim, in the wilderness that is opposite Moab, toward the sunrise.

verses.kjv: From thence they removed, and pitched in the valley of Zared.
verses.modern: From there they set out and camped in the Valley of Zered.

verses.kjv: From thence they removed, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, which is in the wilderness that cometh out of the coasts of the Amorites: for Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.
verses.modern: From there they set out and camped on the other side of the Arnon, which is in the wilderness that extends from the border of the Amorites, for the Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

verses.kjv: Wherefore it is said in the book of the wars of the LORD, What he did in the Red sea, and in the brooks of Arnon,
verses.modern: Therefore it is said in the Book of the Wars of the LORD, 'What He did in the Red sea, and in the brooks of Arnon,

verses.kjv: And at the stream of the brooks that goeth down to the dwelling of Ar, and lieth upon the border of Moab.
verses.modern: the slope of the valleys that extends to the dwelling of Ar, and leans to the border of Moab.'

verses.kjv: And from thence they went to Beer: that is the well whereof the LORD spake unto Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.
verses.modern: from there they continued to Beer; that is the well of which the LORD said to Moses, 'Gather the people together, so that I may give them water.'

verses.kjv: Then Israel sang this song, Spring up, O well; sing ye unto it:
verses.modern: Then Israel sang this song: 'Spring up, O well! — sing to it! —

verses.kjv: The princes digged the well, the nobles of the people digged it, by the direction of the lawgiver, with their staves. And from the wilderness they went to Mattanah:
verses.modern: the well that the princes dug, that the nobles of the people excavated, with the scepter and with their staffs.' And from the wilderness they went on to Mattanah,

verses.kjv: And from Mattanah to Nahaliel: and from Nahaliel to Bamoth:
verses.modern: from Mattanah to Nahaliel, and from Nahaliel to Bamoth,

verses.kjv: And from Bamoth in the valley, that is in the country of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looketh toward Jeshimon.
verses.modern: from Bamoth to the valley lying in the region of Moab by the top of Pisgah that looks down on the desert.

verses.kjv: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,
verses.modern: Then Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,

verses.kjv: Let me pass through thy land: we will not turn into the fields, or into the vineyards; we will not drink of the waters of the well: but we will go along by the king's high way, until we be past thy borders.
verses.modern: 'Let me pass through your land. We will not turn aside into field or vineyard. We will not drink the water of a well. We will go by the King's Highway until we have passed through your territory.'

verses.kjv: And Sihon would not suffer Israel to pass through his border: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness: and he came to Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
verses.modern: But Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his territory. He gathered all his people together and went out against Israel to the wilderness and came to Jahaz and fought against Israel.

verses.kjv: And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from Arnon unto Jabbok, even unto the children of Ammon: for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.
verses.modern: Israel defeated him with the sword and took possession of his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, as far as to the Ammonites, for the border of the Ammonites was strong.

verses.kjv: And Israel took all these cities: and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all the villages thereof.
verses.modern: Israel took all these cities. Israel settled in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all its villages.

verses.kjv: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even unto Arnon.
verses.modern: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab and taken all his land out of his hand, as far as the Arnon.

verses.kjv: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say, Come into Heshbon, let the city of Sihon be built and prepared:
verses.modern: Therefore the ballad singers say, 'Come to Heshbon, let it be built; let the city of Sihon be established.

verses.kjv: For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon: it hath consumed Ar of Moab, and the lords of the high places of Arnon.
verses.modern: For fire came out from Heshbon, flame from the city of Sihon. It devoured Ar of Moab, and swallowed the heights of the Arnon.

verses.kjv: Woe to thee, Moab! thou art undone, O people of Chemosh: he hath given his sons that escaped, and his daughters, into captivity unto Sihon king of the Amorites.
verses.modern: Woe to you, O Moab! You are undone, O people of Chemosh! He has made his sons fugitives. His daughters captives, to an Amorite king, Sihon.

verses.kjv: We have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon, and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah, which reacheth unto Medeba.
verses.modern: So we overthrew them; Heshbon, as far as Dibon, perished. And we laid waste as far as Nophah; fire spread as far as Medeba.'

verses.kjv: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites.
verses.modern: So Israel lived in the land of the Amorites.

verses.kjv: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer, and they took the villages thereof, and drove out the Amorites that were there.
verses.modern: Moses sent to spy out Jazer. They captured its villages and dispossessed the Amorites who were there.

verses.kjv: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he, and all his people, to the battle at Edrei.
verses.modern: Then they turned and went up by the way to Bashan. And Og the king of Bashan came out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Fear him not: for I have delivered him into thy hand, and all his people, and his land; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.
verses.modern: But the LORD said to Moses, 'Do not fear him, for I have given him into your hand. All His people. His land. And you shall do to Him as You did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.'

verses.kjv: So they smote him, and his sons, and all his people, until there was none left him alive: and they possessed his land.
verses.modern: So they defeated Him and His sons and all His people, until He had no survivor left. And they possessed His land.

chapters.summary: Israel defeats the Canaanite king of Arad, then grows impatient and speaks against God and Moses. The LORD sends fiery serpents that kill many; when the people repent, Moses makes a bronze serpent on a pole and all who look at it live. Israel then defeats Sihon king of the Amorites and Og king of Bashan.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in the plains of Moab on this side Jordan by Jericho.
verses.modern: Then the people of Israel set out and camped in the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan at Jericho.

verses.kjv: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.
verses.modern: Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.

verses.kjv: And Moab was sore afraid of the people, because they were many: and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.
verses.modern: Moab was in great dread of the people, because they were many. Moab was overcome with fear of the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And Moab said unto the elders of Midian, Now shall this company lick up all that are round about us, as the ox licketh up the grass of the field. And Balak the son of Zippor was king of the Moabites at that time.
verses.modern: Moab said to the elders of Midian, 'This horde will now lick up all that is around us, as the ox licks up the grass of the field.' So Balak the son of Zippor, who was king of Moab at that time,

verses.kjv: He sent messengers therefore unto Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor, which is by the river of the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, Behold, there is a people come out from Egypt: behold, they cover the face of the earth, and they abide over against me:
verses.modern: sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor at Pethor, which is near the River in the land of the children of His people, to call Him, saying, 'There is a people who have come out of Egypt. They cover the face of the earth. They are dwelling opposite me.

verses.kjv: Come now therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people; for they are too mighty for me: peradventure I shall prevail, that we may smite them, and that I may drive them out of the land: for I wot that he whom thou blessest is blessed, and he whom thou cursest is cursed.
verses.modern: Come now, curse this people for me, since they are too mighty for me. Perhaps I shall be able to defeat them and drive them from the land, for I know that He whom You bless is blessed. He whom You curse is cursed.'

verses.kjv: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand; and they came unto Balaam, and spake unto him the words of Balak.
verses.modern: So the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the fees for divination in their hand. And they came to Balaam and gave Him Balak's message.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as the LORD shall speak unto me: and the princes of Moab abode with Balaam.
verses.modern: he said to them, 'Lodge here tonight. I will bring You word again, as the LORD speaks to me.' So the princes of Moab stayed with Balaam.

verses.kjv: And God came unto Balaam, and said, What men are these with thee?
verses.modern: God came to Balaam and said, 'Who are these men with You?'

verses.kjv: And Balaam said unto God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, hath sent unto me, saying,
verses.modern: Balaam said to God, 'Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has sent to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Behold, there is a people come out of Egypt, which covereth the face of the earth: come now, curse me them; peradventure I shall be able to overcome them, and drive them out.
verses.modern: "There is a people who have come out of Egypt. They cover the face of the earth. Come now, curse them for me. Perhaps I shall be able to fight against them and drive them out."'

verses.kjv: And God said unto Balaam, Thou shalt not go with them; thou shalt not curse the people: for they are blessed.
verses.modern: God said to Balaam, 'You shall not go with them. You shall not curse the people, for they are blessed.'

verses.kjv: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and said unto the princes of Balak, Get you into your land: for the LORD refuseth to give me leave to go with you.
verses.modern: So Balaam rose in the morning and said to the princes of Balak, 'Go back to Your own land, for the LORD has refused to let me go with You.'

verses.kjv: And the princes of Moab rose up, and they went unto Balak, and said, Balaam refuseth to come with us.
verses.modern: So the princes of Moab rose and went to Balak and said, 'Balaam refuses to come with us.'

verses.kjv: And Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honourable than they.
verses.modern: Then Balak sent again a larger number of more distinguished officials than these.

verses.kjv: And they came to Balaam, and said to him, Thus saith Balak the son of Zippor, Let nothing, I pray thee, hinder thee from coming unto me:
verses.modern: they came to Balaam and said to Him, 'Thus says Balak the son of Zippor: "Let nothing hinder You from coming to me,

verses.kjv: For I will promote thee unto very great honour, and I will do whatsoever thou sayest unto me: come therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people.
verses.modern: for I will surely do You great honor, and whatever You say to me I will do. Come, curse this people for me."'

verses.kjv: And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of the LORD my God, to do less or more.
verses.modern: But Balaam answered and said to the servants of Balak, 'Though Balak were to give me His house full of silver and gold, I could not go beyond the command of the LORD my God to do less or more.

verses.kjv: Now therefore, I pray you, tarry ye also here this night, that I may know what the LORD will say unto me more.
verses.modern: So You, too, please stay here tonight, that I may know what more the LORD will say to me.'

verses.kjv: And God came unto Balaam at night, and said unto him, If the men come to call thee, rise up, and go with them; but yet the word which I shall say unto thee, that shalt thou do.
verses.modern: God came to Balaam at night and said to Him, 'If the men have come to call You, rise, go with them; but only do what I tell You.'

verses.kjv: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.
verses.modern: So Balaam rose in the morning and saddled his donkey and went with the princes of Moab.

verses.kjv: And God's anger was kindled because he went: and the angel of the LORD stood in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding upon his ass, and his two servants were with him.
verses.modern: But God's anger was kindled because He went, and the angel of the LORD took His stand in the road as His adversary. Now He was riding on the donkey. His two servants were with Him.

verses.kjv: And the ass saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the ass, to turn her into the way.
verses.modern: the donkey saw the angel of the LORD standing in the road, with a drawn sword in His hand. And the donkey turned aside out of the road and went into the field. And Balaam struck the donkey, to turn her into the road.

verses.kjv: Then the angel of the LORD stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.
verses.modern: Then the angel of the LORD stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, with a wall on one side and a wall on the other.

verses.kjv: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD, she thrust herself unto the wall, and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall: and he smote her again.
verses.modern: when the donkey saw the angel of the LORD, she pressed against the wall and pressed Balaam's foot against the wall. So He struck her again.

verses.kjv: And the angel of the LORD went further, and stood in a narrow place, where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.
verses.modern: Then the angel of the LORD went ahead and stood in a narrow place, where there was no way to turn either to the right or to the left.

verses.kjv: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD, she fell down under Balaam: and Balaam's anger was kindled, and he smote the ass with a staff.
verses.modern: When the donkey saw the angel of the LORD, she lay down under Balaam. And Balaam's anger was kindled. He struck the donkey with His staff.

verses.kjv: And the LORD opened the mouth of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?
verses.modern: Then the LORD opened the mouth of the donkey. She said to Balaam, 'What have I done to You, that You have struck me these three times?'

verses.kjv: And Balaam said unto the ass, Because thou hast mocked me: I would there were a sword in mine hand, for now would I kill thee.
verses.modern: Balaam said to the donkey, 'Because You have made a fool of me. I wish I had a sword in my hand, for then I would kill You.'

verses.kjv: And the ass said unto Balaam, Am not I thine ass, upon which thou hast ridden ever since I was thine unto this day? was I ever wont to do so unto thee? And he said, Nay.
verses.modern: the donkey said to Balaam, 'Am I not Your donkey, on which You have ridden all Your life long to this day? Is it my habit to treat You this way?' And He said, 'No.'

verses.kjv: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and he bowed down his head, and fell flat on his face.
verses.modern: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam. He saw the angel of the LORD standing in the road, with His drawn sword in His hand. And He bowed down and fell on His face.

verses.kjv: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times? behold, I went out to withstand thee, because thy way is perverse before me:
verses.modern: the angel of the LORD said to Him, 'Why have You struck Your donkey these three times? I have come out to oppose You because Your way is perverse before me.

verses.kjv: And the ass saw me, and turned from me these three times: unless she had turned from me, surely now also I had slain thee, and saved her alive.
verses.modern: The donkey saw me and turned aside before me these three times. If she had not turned aside from me, surely just now I would have killed You and let her live.'

verses.kjv: And Balaam said unto the angel of the LORD, I have sinned; for I knew not that thou stoodest in the way against me: now therefore, if it displease thee, I will get me back again.
verses.modern: Then Balaam said to the angel of the LORD, 'I have sinned, for I did not know that You stood in the road against me. Now therefore, if it is evil in Your sight, I will turn back.'

verses.kjv: And the angel of the LORD said unto Balaam, Go with the men: but only the word that I shall speak unto thee, that thou shalt speak. So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
verses.modern: the angel of the LORD said to Balaam, 'Go with the men, but speak only the word that I tell You.' So Balaam went on with the princes of Balak.

verses.kjv: And when Balak heard that Balaam was come, he went out to meet him unto a city of Moab, which is in the border of Arnon, which is in the utmost coast.
verses.modern: When Balak heard that Balaam had come, He went out to meet Him at the city of Moab, on the border formed by the Arnon, at the extremity of the border.

verses.kjv: And Balak said unto Balaam, Did I not earnestly send unto thee to call thee? wherefore camest thou not unto me? am I not able indeed to promote thee to honour?
verses.modern: Balak said to Balaam, 'Did I not send to You to call You? Why did You not come to me? Am I not able to honor You?'

verses.kjv: And Balaam said unto Balak, Lo, I am come unto thee: have I now any power at all to say any thing? the word that God putteth in my mouth, that shall I speak.
verses.modern: Balaam said to Balak, 'I have come to You now. Have I any power of my own to speak anything? The word that God puts in my mouth, that must I speak.'

verses.kjv: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came unto Kirjathhuzoth.
verses.modern: Then Balaam went with Balak. They came to Kiriath-huzoth.

verses.kjv: And Balak offered oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes that were with him.
verses.modern: Balak sacrificed oxen and sheep, and sent some to Balaam and to the princes who were with Him.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal, that thence he might see the utmost part of the people.
verses.modern: on the next day Balak took Balaam and brought Him up to Bamoth-baal, and from there He could see the nearest portion of the people.

chapters.summary: Balak king of Moab, terrified of Israel, sends messengers to hire the prophet Balaam to curse them. God forbids Balaam to go, then permits him to go with the condition that he speak only God's words; on the way, the LORD's angel blocks the road and Balaam's donkey speaks to him.

verses.kjv: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams.
verses.modern: Balaam said to Balak, 'Build for me here seven altars, and prepare for me here seven bulls and seven rams.'

verses.kjv: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bullock and a ram.
verses.modern: Balak did as Balaam said. And Balak and Balaam offered on each altar a bull and a ram.

verses.kjv: And Balaam said unto Balak, Stand by thy burnt offering, and I will go: peradventure the LORD will come to meet me: and whatsoever he sheweth me I will tell thee. And he went to an high place.
verses.modern: Balaam said to Balak, 'Stand beside Your burnt offering. I will go. Perhaps the LORD will come to meet me, and whatever He shows me I will tell You.' And He went to a bare height.

verses.kjv: And God met Balaam: and he said unto him, I have prepared seven altars, and I have offered upon every altar a bullock and a ram.
verses.modern: God met Balaam, and Balaam said to Him, 'I have arranged the seven altars and have offered on each altar a bull and a ram.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD put a word in Balaam's mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus thou shalt speak.
verses.modern: the LORD put a word in Balaam's mouth and said, 'Return to Balak, and thus You shall speak.'

verses.kjv: And he returned unto him, and, lo, he stood by his burnt sacrifice, he, and all the princes of Moab.
verses.modern: he returned to Him, and there He was, standing beside His burnt offering, He and all the princes of Moab.

verses.kjv: And he took up his parable, and said, Balak the king of Moab hath brought me from Aram, out of the mountains of the east, saying, Come, curse me Jacob, and come, defy Israel.
verses.modern: Balaam took up his discourse and said, 'From Aram Balak has brought me, the king of Moab from the eastern mountains: "Come, curse Jacob for me, and come, denounce Israel!"

verses.kjv: How shall I curse, whom God hath not cursed? or how shall I defy, whom the LORD hath not defied?
verses.modern: How can I curse whom God has not cursed? How can I denounce whom the LORD has not denounced?

verses.kjv: For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him: lo, the people shall dwell alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.
verses.modern: For from the top of the crags I see Him, from the hills I see Him; a people dwelling alone, and not counting itself among the nations.

verses.kjv: Who can count the dust of Jacob, and the number of the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, and let my last end be like his!
verses.modern: Who can count the dust of Jacob or number the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the upright, and let my end be like his!'

verses.kjv: And Balak said unto Balaam, What hast thou done unto me? I took thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast blessed them altogether.
verses.modern: Balak said to Balaam, 'What have you done to me? I took you to curse my enemies, and here you have done nothing but bless them.'

verses.kjv: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which the LORD hath put in my mouth?
verses.modern: he answered and said, 'Must I not take care to speak what the LORD puts in my mouth?'

verses.kjv: And Balak said unto him, Come, I pray thee, with me unto another place, from whence thou mayest see them: thou shalt see but the utmost part of them, and shalt not see them all: and curse me them from thence.
verses.modern: Balak said to Him, 'Please come with me to another place, from which You may see them. You shall see only a portion of them and shall not see them all. Then curse them for me from there.'

verses.kjv: And he brought him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.
verses.modern: he took Him to the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.

verses.kjv: And he said unto Balak, Stand here by thy burnt offering, while I meet the LORD yonder.
verses.modern: Balaam said to Balak, 'Stand here beside Your burnt offering, while I meet the LORD over there.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Go again unto Balak, and say thus.
verses.modern: the LORD met Balaam and put a word in His mouth and said, 'Return to Balak, and thus shall You speak.'

verses.kjv: And he came to him, and, lo, he stood by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What hath the LORD spoken?
verses.modern: he came to Him, and there He was, standing beside His burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with Him. And Balak said to Him, 'What has the LORD spoken?'

verses.kjv: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; hearken unto me, thou son of Zippor:
verses.modern: Balaam took up His discourse and said, 'Rise, Balak, and hear; give ear to me, O son of Zippor.

verses.kjv: God is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do it? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?
verses.modern: God is not man, that He should lie, or a son of man, that He should change His mind. Has He said, and will He not do it? Or has He spoken, and will He not fulfill it?

verses.kjv: Behold, I have received commandment to bless: and he hath blessed; and I cannot reverse it.
verses.modern: I have received a command to bless; He has blessed. I cannot revoke it.

verses.kjv: He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob, neither hath he seen perverseness in Israel: the LORD his God is with him, and the shout of a king is among them.
verses.modern: He has not observed misfortune in Jacob, nor has he seen trouble in Israel. The LORD their God is with them, and the shout of a king is among them.

verses.kjv: God brought them out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn.
verses.modern: God brings them out of Egypt and is for them like the strength of a unicorn.

verses.kjv: Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel: according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought!
verses.modern: For there is no enchantment against Jacob, no divination against Israel; now it shall be said of Jacob and Israel, "What has God done!"

verses.kjv: Behold, the people shall rise up as a great lion, and lift up himself as a young lion: he shall not lie down until he eat of the prey, and drink the blood of the slain.
verses.modern: A people rises like a lioness; it rouses itself like a lion — it does not lie down until it has devoured the prey and drunk the blood of the slain.'

verses.kjv: And Balak said unto Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.
verses.modern: Then Balak said to Balaam, 'Do not curse them at all, and do not bless them at all.'

verses.kjv: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak, Told not I thee, saying, All that the LORD speaketh, that I must do?
verses.modern: But Balaam answered Balak, 'Did I not tell You, "All that the LORD speaks, that I must do"?'

verses.kjv: And Balak said unto Balaam, Come, I pray thee, I will bring thee unto another place; peradventure it will please God that thou mayest curse me them from thence.
verses.modern: Balak said to Balaam, 'Come now, I will take You to another place. Perhaps it will please God that You may curse them for me from there.'

verses.kjv: And Balak brought Balaam unto the top of Peor, that looketh toward Jeshimon.
verses.modern: So Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, which overlooks the desert.

verses.kjv: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.
verses.modern: Balaam said to Balak, 'Build for me here seven altars, and prepare for me here seven bulls and seven rams.'

verses.kjv: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.
verses.modern: Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.

chapters.summary: Balak brings Balaam to three different high places to curse Israel, but each time the LORD puts a blessing in Balaam's mouth instead. Balaam declares that God is not a man that He should lie, and that He has blessed Israel and cannot reverse it.

verses.kjv: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he went not, as at other times, to seek for enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.
verses.modern: When Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, He did not go, as at other times, to look for omens, but set His face toward the wilderness.

verses.kjv: And Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel abiding in his tents according to their tribes; and the spirit of God came upon him.
verses.modern: Balaam lifted up His eyes and saw Israel camping tribe by tribe. And the Spirit of God came upon Him,

verses.kjv: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:
verses.modern: he took up his discourse and said, 'The oracle of Balaam the son of Beor, the oracle of the man whose eye is opened,

verses.kjv: He hath said, which heard the words of God, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:
verses.modern: the oracle of Him who hears the words of God, Who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down with His eyes uncovered:

verses.kjv: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, and thy tabernacles, O Israel!
verses.modern: How lovely are your tents, O Jacob, your encampments, O Israel!

verses.kjv: As the valleys are they spread forth, as gardens by the river's side, as the trees of lign aloes which the LORD hath planted, and as cedar trees beside the waters.
verses.modern: Like palm groves that stretch out, like gardens beside a river, like aloes that the LORD has planted, like cedar trees beside the waters.

verses.kjv: He shall pour the water out of his buckets, and his seed shall be in many waters, and his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.
verses.modern: Water shall flow from His buckets. His seed shall be in many waters; His king shall be higher than Agag. His kingdom shall be exalted.

verses.kjv: God brought him forth out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn: he shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce them through with his arrows.
verses.modern: God brings Him out of Egypt and is for Him like the strength of a unicorn; He shall devour the nations, his adversaries, and shall break their bones in pieces and pierce them through with his arrows.

verses.kjv: He couched, he lay down as a lion, and as a great lion: who shall stir him up? Blessed is he that blesseth thee, and cursed is he that curseth thee.
verses.modern: He crouched, He lay down like a lion and like a lioness; who will rouse Him up? Blessed are those who bless You, and cursed are those who curse You.'

verses.kjv: And Balak's anger was kindled against Balaam, and he smote his hands together: and Balak said unto Balaam, I called thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast altogether blessed them these three times.
