verses.modern: Balak's anger was kindled against Balaam. He struck His hands together. And Balak said to Balaam, 'I called You to curse my enemies, and You have blessed them these three times.

verses.kjv: Therefore now flee thou to thy place: I thought to promote thee unto great honour; but, lo, the LORD hath kept thee back from honour.
verses.modern: Therefore now flee to Your own place. I said I would greatly honor You. But The LORD has held You back from honor.'

verses.kjv: And Balaam said unto Balak, Spake I not also to thy messengers which thou sentest unto me, saying,
verses.modern: Balaam said to Balak, 'Did I not tell Your messengers whom You sent to me,

verses.kjv: If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the commandment of the LORD, to do either good or bad of mine own mind; but what the LORD saith, that will I speak?
verses.modern: "If Balak should give me His house full of silver and gold, I would not be able to go beyond the word of the LORD, to do either good or bad of my own will. What the LORD speaks, that will I speak"?

verses.kjv: And now, behold, I go unto my people: come therefore, and I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days.
verses.modern: now, I am going to my people. Come, I will let You know what this people will do to Your people in the latter days.'

verses.kjv: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:
verses.modern: he took up his discourse and said, 'The oracle of Balaam the son of Beor, the oracle of the man whose eye is opened,

verses.kjv: He hath said, which heard the words of God, and knew the knowledge of the most High, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:
verses.modern: the oracle of Him who hears the words of God, and knows the knowledge of the Most High, Who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down with His eyes uncovered:

verses.kjv: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.
verses.modern: I see him, but not now; I behold him, but not near: a star shall come out of Jacob, and a scepter shall rise out of Israel; it shall crush the forehead of Moab and break down all the sons of Sheth.

verses.kjv: And Edom shall be a possession, Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies; and Israel shall do valiantly.
verses.modern: Edom shall be dispossessed; Seir also, his enemies, shall be dispossessed. Israel is doing valiantly.

verses.kjv: Out of Jacob shall come he that shall have dominion, and shall destroy him that remaineth of the city.
verses.modern: one from Jacob shall exercise dominion and destroy the survivors of cities!'

verses.kjv: And when he looked on Amalek, he took up his parable, and said, Amalek was the first of the nations; but his latter end shall be that he perish for ever.
verses.modern: Then he looked on Amalek and took up his discourse and said, 'Amalek was the first among the nations, but its end is destruction.'

verses.kjv: And he looked on the Kenites, and took up his parable, and said, Strong is thy dwelling place, and thou puttest thy nest in a rock.
verses.modern: he looked on the Kenite and took up his discourse and said, 'Enduring is your dwelling place, and your nest is set in the rock.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless the Kenite shall be wasted, until Asshur shall carry thee away captive.
verses.modern: Nevertheless, the Kenite shall be wasted when Asshur takes you away captive.'

verses.kjv: And he took up his parable, and said, Alas, who shall live when God doeth this!
verses.modern: he took up his discourse and said, 'Alas, who shall live when God does this?

verses.kjv: And ships shall come from the coast of Chittim, and shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber, and he also shall perish for ever.
verses.modern: But ships shall come from Kittim and shall afflict Asshur and Eber. He too shall come to destruction.'

verses.kjv: And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place: and Balak also went his way.
verses.modern: Then Balaam rose and went back to his place. And Balak also went his way.

chapters.summary: Balaam speaks two more oracles blessing Israel, prophesying that a star shall come out of Jacob and a scepter shall rise out of Israel. He then pronounces oracles against Moab, Amalek, the Kenites, and Assyria before returning home.

verses.kjv: And Israel abode in Shittim, and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab.
verses.modern: While Israel lived in Shittim, the people began to whore with the daughters of Moab.

verses.kjv: And they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods: and the people did eat, and bowed down to their gods.
verses.modern: These women invited the people to the sacrifices of their gods, and the people ate and bowed down to their gods.

verses.kjv: And Israel joined himself unto Baalpeor: and the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel.
verses.modern: So Israel yoked Himself to Baal of Peor. And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take all the heads of the people, and hang them up before the LORD against the sun, that the fierce anger of the LORD may be turned away from Israel.
verses.modern: the LORD said to Moses, 'Take all the chiefs of the people and hang them before the LORD in the sun, that the fierce anger of the LORD may turn away from Israel.'

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto the judges of Israel, Slay ye every one his men that were joined unto Baalpeor.
verses.modern: Moses said to the judges of Israel, 'Each of you kill those of his men who have yoked themselves to Baal of Peor.'

verses.kjv: And, behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought unto his brethren a Midianitish woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, who were weeping before the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.modern: just then, one of the people of Israel came and brought a Midianite woman to his family, in the sight of Moses and in the sight of the whole congregation of the people of Israel, while they were weeping in the entrance of the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: And when Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from among the congregation, and took a javelin in his hand;
verses.modern: When Phinehas the son of Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose and left the congregation and took a spear in his hand

verses.kjv: And he went after the man of Israel into the tent, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her belly. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.
verses.modern: went after the man of Israel into the inner room and pierced both of them, the man of Israel and the woman through her belly. So the plague on the people of Israel was stopped.

verses.kjv: And those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand.
verses.modern: Nevertheless those who died by the plague were 24,000.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, while he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy.
verses.modern: 'Phinehas the son of Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest, has turned back my wrath from the people of Israel, in that he was jealous with my jealousy among them, so that I did not consume the people of Israel in my jealousy.

verses.kjv: Wherefore say, Behold, I give unto him my covenant of peace:
verses.modern: Therefore say, "I am giving him my covenant of peace,

verses.kjv: And he shall have it, and his seed after him, even the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was zealous for his God, and made an atonement for the children of Israel.
verses.modern: it shall be to him and to his descendants after him the covenant of a perpetual priesthood, because he was jealous for his God and made atonement for the people of Israel."'

verses.kjv: Now the name of the Israelite that was slain, even that was slain with the Midianitish woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites.
verses.modern: The name of the slain man of Israel, who was killed with the Midianite woman, was Zimri the son of Salu, a chief of a fathers' house belonging to the Simeonites.

verses.kjv: And the name of the Midianitish woman that was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he was head over a people, and of a chief house in Midian.
verses.modern: the name of the Midianite woman who was killed was Cozbi the daughter of Zur, who was the head of a clan, a chief's house in Midian.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Vex the Midianites, and smite them:
verses.modern: 'Harass the Midianites and strike them down,

verses.kjv: For they vex you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, which was slain in the day of the plague for Peor's sake.
verses.modern: for they have harassed You with their wiles, with which they beguiled You in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of the chief of Midian, their sister, who was killed on the day of the plague on account of Peor.'

chapters.summary: Israel commits whoredom with the daughters of Moab and worships Baal of Peor, provoking the LORD's anger. A plague kills 24,000 before Phinehas the priest drives a spear through an Israelite man and a Midianite woman; the LORD rewards Phinehas with a covenant of everlasting priesthood.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass after the plague, that the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,
verses.modern: After the plague the LORD said to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest,

verses.kjv: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, throughout their fathers' house, all that are able to go to war in Israel.
verses.modern: 'Take a census of all the congregation of the people of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, by their fathers' houses, all in Israel who are able to go to war.'

verses.kjv: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spake with them in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
verses.modern: Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

verses.kjv: Take the sum of the people, from twenty years old and upward; as the LORD commanded Moses and the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt.
verses.modern: 'Take a census of the people, from twenty years old and upward,' as the LORD commanded Moses. The people of Israel who came out of the land of Egypt were:

verses.kjv: Reuben, the eldest son of Israel: the children of Reuben; Hanoch, of whom cometh the family of the Hanochites: of Pallu, the family of the Palluites:
verses.modern: Reuben, the firstborn of Israel; the sons of Reuben: of Hanoch, the clan of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the clan of the Palluites;

verses.kjv: Of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.
verses.modern: of Hezron, the clan of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the clan of the Carmites.

verses.modern: the sons of Pallu: Eliab.

verses.modern: The sons of Eliab: Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are the Dathan and Abiram, chosen from the congregation, who contended against Moses and Aaron in the company of Korah, when they contended against the LORD

verses.modern: the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died, when the fire devoured 250 men. They became a warning.

verses.modern: But the sons of Korah did not die.

verses.modern: The sons of Simeon according to their clans: of Nemuel, the clan of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the clan of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the clan of the Jachinites;

verses.kjv: Of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites: of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.
verses.modern: of Zerah, the clan of the Zerahites; of Shaul, the clan of the Shaulites.

verses.kjv: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty and two thousand and two hundred.

chapters.summary: After the plague, the LORD commands a second census of all men twenty years old and older who are able to go to war. The total count is 601,730 -- nearly the same as the first census. Not one man counted in the first census at Sinai remains alive except Caleb and Joshua.

verses.kjv: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph: and these are the names of his daughters; Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.

verses.kjv: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
verses.modern: they stood before Moses and before Eleazar the priest and before the chiefs and all the congregation, at the entrance of the tent of meeting, saying,

verses.modern: 'Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among the company of those who gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah, but died for His own sin. And He had no sons.

verses.kjv: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he hath no son? Give unto us therefore a possession among the brethren of our father.
verses.modern: Why should the name of our father be taken away from His clan because He had no son? Give to us a possession among our father's brothers.'

verses.kjv: And Moses brought their cause before the LORD.
verses.modern: Moses brought their case before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father's brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.
verses.modern: 'The daughters of Zelophehad are right. You shall give them possession of an inheritance among their father's brothers and transfer the inheritance of their father to them.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a man die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.
verses.modern: you shall speak to the people of Israel, saying, "If a man dies and has no son, then you shall transfer His inheritance to His daughter.

verses.kjv: And if he have no daughter, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.

verses.kjv: And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father's brethren.
verses.modern: if He has no brothers, then You shall give His inheritance to His father's brothers.

verses.kjv: And if his father have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of judgment, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.modern: if His father has no brothers, then You shall give His inheritance to the nearest kinsman of His clan. He shall possess it. And it shall be for the people of Israel a statute and rule, as the LORD commanded Moses."'

verses.modern: When you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as your brother Aaron was gathered,

chapters.summary: The daughters of Zelophehad successfully petition Moses for an inheritance in the Promised Land since their father died without sons, and the LORD establishes the law of inheritance for all Israel. The LORD tells Moses to go up Mount Abarim and see the land, then commissions Joshua the son of Nun as Moses's successor.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My offering, and my bread for my sacrifices made by fire, for a sweet savour unto me, shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season.
verses.modern: 'Command the people of Israel and say to them, "My offering, my food for my offerings made by fire, my sweet savour, You shall be careful to offer to me at its appointed time."

verses.kjv: And thou shalt say unto them, This is the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto the LORD; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, for a continual burnt offering.
verses.modern: you shall say to them, "This is the offering made by fire that You shall offer to the LORD: two male lambs a year old without blemish, day by day, as a regular burnt offering.

verses.kjv: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even;
verses.modern: One lamb You shall offer in the morning, and the other lamb You shall offer at twilight;

verses.kjv: And a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat offering, mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil.

verses.kjv: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.modern: It is a regular burnt offering, which was ordained at Mount Sinai for a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the drink offering thereof shall be the fourth part of an hin for the one lamb: in the holy place shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the LORD for a drink offering.
verses.modern: Its drink offering shall be a quarter of a hin for each lamb. In the sanctuary You shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even: as the meat offering of the morning, and as the drink offering thereof, thou shalt offer it, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.modern: The other lamb You shall offer at twilight. Like the grain offering of the morning and like its drink offering, You shall offer it as a offering made by fire, a sweet savour unto the LORD.

verses.kjv: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot, and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and the drink offering thereof:

verses.modern: this is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, besides the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.

verses.modern: a tenth of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering for every lamb; for a burnt offering of sweet savour, a offering made by fire to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine unto a bullock, and the third part of an hin unto a ram, and a fourth part of an hin unto a lamb: this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

chapters.summary: The LORD prescribes the offerings for the Feast of Trumpets on the first day of the seventh month, the Day of Atonement on the tenth, and the Feast of Tabernacles from the fifteenth through the twenty-second. The Feast of Tabernacles requires a decreasing number of bulls over its seven days, totaling seventy bulls.

verses.kjv: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded.
verses.modern: Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the people of Israel, saying, 'This is what the LORD has commanded.

verses.kjv: If a man vow a vow unto the LORD, or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond; he shall not break his word, he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth.
verses.modern: If a man vows a vow to the LORD, or swears an oath to bind Himself by a pledge, He shall not break His word. He shall do according to all that proceeds out of His mouth.

verses.kjv: If a woman also vow a vow unto the LORD, and bind herself by a bond, being in her father's house in her youth;
verses.modern: If a woman vows a vow to the LORD and binds herself by a pledge, while within her father's house in her youth,

verses.kjv: And her father hear her vow, and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul, and her father shall hold his peace at her; then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.
verses.modern: her father hears of her vow and of her pledge by which she has bound herself and says nothing to her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge by which she has bound herself shall stand.

verses.kjv: But if her father disallow her in the day that he heareth; not any of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand: and the LORD shall forgive her, because her father disallowed her.
verses.modern: But if her father opposes her on the day that He hears of it, none of her vows or her pledges by which she has bound herself shall stand. And the LORD will forgive her, because her father had opposed her.

verses.kjv: And if she had at all an husband, when she vowed, or uttered ought out of her lips, wherewith she bound her soul;
verses.modern: If she marries a husband, while under her vows or any thoughtless pledge by which she has bound herself,

verses.kjv: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her in the day that he heard it: then her vows shall stand, and her bonds wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.
verses.modern: her husband hears of it and says nothing to her on the day that He hears, then her vows shall stand. Her pledges by which she bound herself shall stand.

verses.kjv: But if her husband disallowed her on the day that he heard it; then he shall make her vow which she vowed, and that which she uttered with her lips, wherewith she bound her soul, of none effect: and the LORD shall forgive her.
verses.modern: But if, on the day that her husband comes to hear of it, He opposes her, then He makes void her vow that was on her, and the thoughtless pledge she uttered. And the LORD will forgive her.

verses.kjv: But every vow of a widow, and of her that is divorced, wherewith they have bound their souls, shall stand against her.
verses.modern: But any vow of a widow or of a divorced woman, anything by which she has bound herself, shall stand against her.

verses.kjv: And if she vowed in her husband's house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath;
verses.modern: if she vowed in her husband's house or bound herself by a pledge with an oath

verses.kjv: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her, and disallowed her not: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.
verses.modern: her husband heard of it and said nothing to her and did not oppose her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge by which she bound herself shall stand.

verses.kjv: But if her husband hath utterly made them void on the day he heard them; then whatsoever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand: her husband hath made them void; and the LORD shall forgive her.
verses.modern: But if her husband makes them null and void on the day that He hears them, then whatever proceeds out of her lips concerning her vows or concerning her pledge of herself shall not stand. Her husband has made them void. The LORD will forgive her.

verses.kjv: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.
verses.modern: Any vow and any binding oath to afflict herself, her husband may establish, or her husband may make void.

verses.kjv: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day; then he establisheth all her vows, or all her bonds, which are upon her: he confirmeth them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them.
verses.modern: But if her husband says nothing to her from day to day, then He establishes all her vows or all her pledges that are upon her. He has established them, because He said nothing to her on the day that He heard of them.

verses.kjv: But if he shall any ways make them void after that he hath heard them; then he shall bear her iniquity.
verses.modern: But if He makes them void after He has heard of them, then He shall bear her iniquity.'

verses.kjv: These are the statutes, which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between the father and his daughter, being yet in her youth in her father's house.
verses.modern: These are the statutes that the LORD commanded Moses about a man and his wife and about a father and his daughter while she is in her youth within her father's house.

chapters.summary: Moses gives the law of vows. A man's vow to the LORD is binding in every case, but a woman's vow may be voided by her father if she is in his house, or by her husband on the day he hears of it; if neither objects, her vow stands.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.
verses.modern: 'Avenge the people of Israel on the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to Your people.'

verses.kjv: And Moses spake unto the people, saying, Arm some of yourselves unto the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge the LORD of Midian.
verses.modern: So Moses spoke to the people, saying, 'Arm men from among you for the war, that they may go against Midian to execute the LORD's vengeance on Midian.

verses.kjv: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.
verses.modern: You shall send a thousand from each of the tribes of Israel to the war.'

verses.kjv: So there were delivered out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
verses.modern: So there were furnished, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand from each tribe — 12,000 armed for war.

verses.kjv: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand of every tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.
verses.modern: Moses sent them to the war, a thousand from each tribe, together with Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.

verses.kjv: And they warred against the Midianites, as the LORD commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.
verses.modern: They warred against Midian, as the LORD commanded Moses, and killed every male.

verses.kjv: And they slew the kings of Midian, beside the rest of them that were slain; namely, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.
verses.modern: They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. And they also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel took all the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took the spoil of all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods.
verses.modern: the people of Israel took captive the women of Midian and their little ones. They took as plunder all their cattle, all their flocks. All their goods.

verses.kjv: And they burnt all their cities wherein they dwelt, and all their goodly castles, with fire.
verses.modern: All their cities in the places where they lived. All their encampments, they burned with fire.

verses.kjv: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of men and of beasts.
verses.modern: they took all the plunder and all the spoil, both of people and of animals.

verses.kjv: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by Jordan near Jericho.
verses.modern: Then they brought the captives and the plunder and the spoil to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the people of Israel, at the camp on the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

verses.kjv: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.
verses.modern: Moses and Eleazar the priest and all the chiefs of the congregation went to meet them outside the camp.

verses.kjv: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, with the captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, which came from the battle.
verses.modern: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the commanders of thousands and the commanders of hundreds, who had come from service in the battle.

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto them, Have ye saved all the women alive?
verses.modern: Moses said to them, 'Have you let all the women live?

verses.kjv: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the LORD in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the LORD.
verses.modern: these, on Balaam's advice, caused the people of Israel to act treacherously against the LORD in the incident of Peor, and so the plague came among the congregation of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.
verses.modern: Now therefore, kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known man by lying with Him.

verses.kjv: But all the women children, that have not known a man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
verses.modern: But all the young girls who have not known man by lying with Him, keep alive for yourselves.

verses.kjv: And do ye abide without the camp seven days: whosoever hath killed any person, and whosoever hath touched any slain, purify both yourselves and your captives on the third day, and on the seventh day.
verses.modern: Encamp outside the camp seven days. Whoever has killed any person and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves and Your captives on the third day and on the seventh day.

verses.kjv: And purify all your raiment, and all that is made of skins, and all work of goats' hair, and all things made of wood.
verses.modern: You shall also purify every garment, every article of skin, all work of goats' hair, and every article of wood.'

verses.kjv: And Eleazar the priest said unto the men of war which went to the battle, This is the ordinance of the law which the LORD commanded Moses;
verses.modern: Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who had gone to battle: 'This is the statute of the law that the LORD has commanded Moses:

verses.kjv: Only the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
verses.modern: only the gold, the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead,

verses.kjv: Every thing that may abide the fire, ye shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean: nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of separation: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make go through the water.
verses.modern: everything that can stand fire, You shall pass through fire. It shall be clean. Nevertheless, it shall also be purified with the water for impurity. And whatever cannot stand fire, You shall pass through water.

verses.kjv: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean, and afterward ye shall come into the camp.
verses.modern: You shall wash Your clothes on the seventh day, and You shall be clean. And afterward You may come into the camp.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation:
verses.modern: 'Take the count of the plunder that was taken, both of people and of animals, you and Eleazar the priest and the heads of the fathers' houses of the congregation.

verses.kjv: And divide the prey into two parts; between them that took the war upon them, who went out to battle, and between all the congregation:
verses.modern: divide the plunder into two parts between the warriors who went out to battle and all the congregation.

verses.kjv: And levy a tribute unto the LORD of the men of war which went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, both of the persons, and of the beeves, and of the asses, and of the sheep:
verses.modern: levy for the LORD a tribute from the men of war who went out to battle, one out of five hundred, of the people and of the oxen and of the donkeys and of the flocks.

verses.kjv: Take it of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, for an heave offering of the LORD.
verses.modern: Take it from their half and give it to Eleazar the priest as a contribution to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And of the children of Israel's half, thou shalt take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the beeves, of the asses, and of the flocks, of all manner of beasts, and give them unto the Levites, which keep the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD.
verses.modern: from the people of Israel's half you shall take one out of every fifty, of the people, of the oxen, of the donkeys, and of the flocks, of every kind of animal, and give them to the Levites who keep guard over the tabernacle of the LORD.'

verses.kjv: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.modern: Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And the booty, being the rest of the prey which the men of war had caught, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,
verses.modern: Now the plunder remaining of the spoil that the men of war had taken was 675,000 sheep,

verses.kjv: And threescore and twelve thousand beeves,
verses.modern: 72,000 cattle,

verses.kjv: And threescore and one thousand asses,
verses.modern: 61,000 donkeys,

verses.kjv: And thirty and two thousand persons in all, of women that had not known man by lying with him.
verses.modern: 32,000 persons in all, women who had not known man by lying with Him.

verses.kjv: And the half, which was the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and seven and thirty thousand and five hundred sheep:
verses.modern: the half, the portion of those who had gone out to war, was in number 337,500 sheep,

verses.kjv: And the LORD's tribute of the sheep was six hundred and threescore and fifteen.
verses.modern: the LORD's tribute of sheep was 675.

verses.kjv: And the beeves were thirty and six thousand; of which the LORD's tribute was threescore and twelve.
verses.modern: The cattle were 36,000, of which the LORD's tribute was 72.

verses.kjv: And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred; of which the LORD's tribute was threescore and one.
verses.modern: The donkeys were 30,500, of which the LORD's tribute was 61.

verses.kjv: And the persons were sixteen thousand; of which the LORD's tribute was thirty and two persons.
verses.modern: The persons were 16,000, of which the LORD's tribute was 32 persons.

verses.kjv: And Moses gave the tribute, which was the LORD's heave offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.modern: Moses gave the tribute, which was the LORD's contribution, to Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And of the children of Israel's half, which Moses divided from the men that warred,
verses.modern: from the people of Israel's half, which Moses separated from that of the men who had gone to war —

verses.kjv: (Now the half that pertained unto the congregation was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep,
verses.modern: now the congregation's half was 337,500 sheep,

verses.kjv: And thirty and six thousand beeves,
verses.modern: 36,000 cattle,

verses.kjv: And thirty thousand asses and five hundred,
verses.modern: 30,500 donkeys,

verses.kjv: And sixteen thousand persons;)
verses.modern: 16,000 persons —

verses.kjv: Even of the children of Israel's half, Moses took one portion of fifty, both of man and of beast, and gave them unto the Levites, which kept the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.modern: from the people of Israel's half Moses took one of every fifty, both of people and of animals, and gave them to the Levites who kept guard over the tabernacle of the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And the officers which were over thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses:
verses.modern: Then the officers who were over the thousands of the army, the commanders of thousands and the commanders of hundreds, came near to Moses

verses.kjv: And they said unto Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war which are under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.
verses.modern: said to Moses, 'Your servants have counted the men of war who are under our command, and there is not a man missing from us.

verses.kjv: We have therefore brought an oblation for the LORD, what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and tablets, to make an atonement for our souls before the LORD.
verses.modern: we have brought the LORD's offering, what each man found, articles of gold, armlets and bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and beads, to make atonement for ourselves before the LORD.'

verses.kjv: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, even all wrought jewels.
verses.modern: Moses and Eleazar the priest received from them the gold, all of it in worked articles.

verses.kjv: And all the gold of the offering that they offered up to the LORD, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.
verses.modern: all the gold of the contribution that they contributed to the LORD, from the commanders of thousands and the commanders of hundreds, was 16,750 shekels.

verses.kjv: (For the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)
verses.modern: The men of war had each taken plunder for Himself.

verses.kjv: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of the congregation, for a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD.
verses.modern: Moses and Eleazar the priest received the gold from the commanders of thousands and of hundreds and brought it into the tent of meeting as a memorial for the people of Israel before the LORD.

chapters.summary: The LORD commands Moses to execute vengeance on the Midianites for leading Israel into sin at Peor. Twelve thousand Israelite soldiers defeat Midian, killing all the males including the five kings of Midian and Balaam the son of Beor; the plunder is divided between the warriors and the congregation.

verses.kjv: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place was a place for cattle;
verses.modern: Now the people of Reuben and the people of Gad had a very great number of livestock. And they saw the land of Jazer and the land of Gilead, and the place was a place for livestock.

verses.kjv: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying,
verses.modern: the people of Gad and the people of Reuben came and said to Moses and to Eleazar the priest and to the chiefs of the congregation,

verses.kjv: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon,
verses.modern: 'Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,

verses.kjv: Even the country which the LORD smote before the congregation of Israel, is a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle:
verses.modern: the land that the LORD struck down before the congregation of Israel, is a land for livestock, and Your servants have livestock.'

verses.kjv: Wherefore, said they, if we have found grace in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession, and bring us not over Jordan.
verses.modern: they said, 'If we have found favor in Your sight, let this land be given to Your servants for a possession. Do not take us across the Jordan.'

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall ye sit here?
verses.modern: But Moses said to the people of Gad and to the people of Reuben, 'Shall your brothers go to the war while you sit here?

verses.kjv: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD hath given them?
verses.modern: Why will You discourage the heart of the people of Israel from going over into the land that the LORD has given them?

verses.kjv: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadeshbarnea to see the land.
verses.modern: Your fathers did this, when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land.

verses.kjv: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.
verses.modern: For when they went up to the Valley of Eshcol and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the people of Israel from going into the land that the LORD had given them.

verses.kjv: And the LORD's anger was kindled the same time, and he sware, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD's anger was kindled on that day. He swore, saying,

verses.kjv: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:
verses.modern: "None of the men who came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land that I swore to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, because they have not wholly followed me —

verses.kjv: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the LORD.
verses.modern: none except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite and Joshua the son of Nun, for they have wholly followed the LORD."

verses.kjv: And the LORD's anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of the LORD, was consumed.
verses.modern: the LORD's anger was kindled against Israel. He made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation that had done evil in the sight of the LORD was gone.

verses.kjv: And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers' stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel.
verses.modern: you have risen in Your fathers' place, a brood of sinful men, to increase still more the fierce anger of the LORD against Israel!

verses.kjv: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye shall destroy all this people.
verses.modern: For if You turn away from following Him, He will again abandon them in the wilderness, and You will destroy all this people.'

verses.kjv: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:
verses.modern: Then they came near to Him and said, 'We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones,

verses.kjv: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
verses.modern: but we will take up arms, ready to go before the people of Israel, until we have brought them to their place. And our little ones shall live in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

verses.kjv: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.
verses.modern: We will not return to our homes until each of the people of Israel has gained his inheritance.

verses.kjv: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side Jordan, or forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward.
verses.modern: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on this side of the Jordan to the east.'

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will go armed before the LORD to war,
verses.modern: Moses said to them, 'If you will do this, if you will take up arms to go before the LORD for the war,

verses.kjv: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before the LORD, until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,
verses.modern: every armed man of You will pass over the Jordan before the LORD, until He has driven out His enemies from before Him

verses.kjv: And the land be subdued before the LORD: then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless before the LORD, and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the LORD.
verses.modern: the land is subdued before the LORD; then after that You shall return and be free of obligation to the LORD and to Israel, and this land shall be Your possession before the LORD.

verses.kjv: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the LORD: and be sure your sin will find you out.
verses.modern: But if You will not do so, You have sinned against the LORD, and be sure Your sin will find You out.

verses.kjv: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.
verses.modern: Build cities for Your little ones and folds for Your sheep, and do what You have promised.'

verses.kjv: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.
verses.modern: the people of Gad and the people of Reuben said to Moses, 'Your servants will do as my lord commands.

verses.kjv: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:
verses.modern: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks. All our livestock shall be there in the cities of Gilead,

verses.kjv: But thy servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord saith.
verses.modern: but Your servants will pass over, every man who is armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord orders.'

verses.kjv: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel:
verses.modern: So Moses gave command concerning them to Eleazar the priest and to Joshua the son of Nun and to the heads of the fathers' houses of the tribes of the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before the LORD, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:
verses.modern: Moses said to them, 'If the people of Gad and the people of Reuben, every man who is armed to battle before the LORD, will pass with You over the Jordan and the land shall be subdued before You, then You shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession.

verses.kjv: But if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.
verses.modern: But if they will not pass over with You armed, they shall have possessions among You in the land of Canaan.'

verses.kjv: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As the LORD hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.
verses.modern: the people of Gad and the people of Reuben answered, 'What the LORD has said to Your servants, we will do.

verses.kjv: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan may be ours.
verses.modern: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.'

verses.kjv: And Moses gave unto them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with the cities thereof in the coasts, even the cities of the country round about.
verses.modern: Moses gave to them — to the people of Gad and to the people of Reuben and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph — the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land and its cities with their territories, the cities of the surrounding land.

verses.kjv: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,
verses.modern: the people of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,

verses.kjv: And Atroth, Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,
verses.modern: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,

verses.kjv: And Bethnimrah, and Bethharan, fenced cities: and folds for sheep.
verses.modern: Beth-nimrah and Beth-haran — fortified cities — and folds for sheep.

verses.kjv: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim,
verses.modern: the people of Reuben built Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,

verses.kjv: And Nebo, and Baalmeon, (their names being changed,) and Shibmah: and gave other names unto the cities which they builded.
verses.modern: Nebo, and Baal-meon (their names were changed) and Sibmah. And they gave other names to the cities that they built.

verses.kjv: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite which was in it.
verses.modern: the sons of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead and captured it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were in it.

verses.kjv: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.
verses.modern: Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh. He settled in it.

verses.kjv: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof, and called them Havothjair.
verses.modern: Jair the son of Manasseh went and captured their villages and called them Havvoth-jair.

verses.kjv: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
verses.modern: Nobah went and captured Kenath and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.

chapters.summary: The tribes of Reuben and Gad, who have large herds, ask Moses for the land east of the Jordan as their inheritance. Moses rebukes them but agrees on the condition that their armed men cross the Jordan and fight alongside the other tribes until Canaan is conquered; the half-tribe of Manasseh also settles east of the Jordan.

verses.kjv: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.modern: These are the stages of the people of Israel, when they went out of the land of Egypt by their companies under the leadership of Moses and Aaron.

verses.kjv: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the LORD: and these are their journeys according to their goings out.
verses.modern: Moses wrote down their starting places, stage by stage, by command of the LORD, and these are their stages according to their starting places.

verses.kjv: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.
verses.modern: They set out from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month. On the day after the Passover, the people of Israel went out triumphantly in the sight of all the Egyptians,

verses.kjv: For the Egyptians buried all their firstborn, which the LORD had smitten among them: upon their gods also the LORD executed judgments.
verses.modern: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom the LORD had struck down among them. On their gods also the LORD executed judgments.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and pitched in Succoth.
verses.modern: So the people of Israel set out from Rameses and camped at Succoth.

verses.kjv: And they departed from Succoth, and pitched in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
verses.modern: they set out from Succoth and camped at Etham, which is on the edge of the wilderness.

verses.kjv: And they removed from Etham, and turned again unto Pihahiroth, which is before Baalzephon: and they pitched before Migdol.
verses.modern: they set out from Etham and turned back to Pi-hahiroth, which is to the east of Baal-zephon. They camped before Migdol.

verses.kjv: And they departed from before Pihahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days' journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.
verses.modern: they set out from before Pihahiroth and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness. They went a three days' journey in the wilderness of Etham and camped at Marah.

verses.kjv: And they removed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim were twelve fountains of water, and threescore and ten palm trees; and they pitched there.
verses.modern: they set out from Marah and came to Elim; at Elim there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees. They camped there.

verses.kjv: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.
verses.modern: they set out from Elim and camped by the Red Sea.

verses.kjv: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
verses.modern: they set out from the Red Sea and camped in the wilderness of Sin.

verses.kjv: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
verses.modern: they set out from the wilderness of Sin and camped at Dophkah.

verses.kjv: And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
verses.modern: they set out from Dophkah and camped at Alush.

verses.kjv: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.
verses.modern: they set out from Alush and camped at Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.

verses.kjv: And they departed from Rephidim, and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.modern: they set out from Rephidim and camped in the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.kjv: And they removed from the desert of Sinai, and pitched at Kibrothhattaavah.
verses.modern: they set out from the wilderness of Sinai and camped at Kibroth-hattaavah.

verses.kjv: And they departed from Kibrothhattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.
verses.modern: they set out from Kibroth-hattaavah and camped at Hazeroth.

verses.kjv: And they departed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah.
verses.modern: they set out from Hazeroth and camped at Rithmah.

verses.kjv: And they departed from Rithmah, and pitched at Rimmonparez.
verses.modern: they set out from Rithmah and camped at Rimmon-perez.

verses.kjv: And they departed from Rimmonparez, and pitched in Libnah.
verses.modern: they set out from Rimmon-perez and camped at Libnah.

verses.kjv: And they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah.
verses.modern: they set out from Libnah and camped at Rissah.

verses.kjv: And they journeyed from Rissah, and pitched in Kehelathah.
verses.modern: they set out from Rissah and camped at Kehelathah.

verses.modern: they set out from Kehelathah and camped at Mount Shepher.

verses.modern: they set out from Makheloth and camped at Tahath.

verses.kjv: And they departed from Tahath, and pitched at Tarah.
verses.modern: they set out from Tahath and camped at Terah.

verses.kjv: And they removed from Tarah, and pitched in Mithcah.
verses.modern: they set out from Terah and camped at Mithkah.

verses.kjv: And they went from Mithcah, and pitched in Hashmonah.
verses.modern: they set out from Mithkah and camped at Hashmonah.

verses.kjv: And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.
verses.modern: they set out from Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth.

verses.kjv: And they departed from Moseroth, and pitched in Benejaakan.
verses.modern: they set out from Moseroth and camped at Bene-jaakan.

verses.kjv: And they removed from Benejaakan, and encamped at Horhagidgad.
verses.modern: they set out from Bene-jaakan and camped at Hor-haggidgad.

verses.kjv: And they went from Horhagidgad, and pitched in Jotbathah.
verses.modern: they set out from Hor-haggidgad and camped at Jotbathah.

verses.kjv: And they removed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Ebronah.
verses.modern: they set out from Jotbathah and camped at Abronah.

verses.kjv: And they departed from Ebronah, and encamped at Eziongaber.
verses.modern: they set out from Abronah and camped at Ezion-geber.

verses.modern: they set out from Ezion-geber and camped in the wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.

verses.kjv: And they removed from Kadesh, and pitched in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
verses.modern: they set out from Kadesh and camped at Mount Hor, on the edge of the land of Edom.

verses.kjv: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the first day of the fifth month.
verses.modern: Aaron the priest went up Mount Hor at the command of the LORD and died there, in the fortieth year after the people of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, on the first day of the fifth month.

verses.kjv: And Aaron was an hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.
verses.modern: Aaron was 123 years old when he died on Mount Hor.

verses.kjv: And king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
verses.modern: the Canaanite, the king of Arad, who dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And they departed from mount Hor, and pitched in Zalmonah.
verses.modern: they set out from Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah.

verses.kjv: And they departed from Zalmonah, and pitched in Punon.
verses.modern: they set out from Zalmonah and camped at Punon.

verses.kjv: And they departed from Oboth, and pitched in Ijeabarim, in the border of Moab.
