verses.modern: they set out from Iyim and camped at Dibon-gad.

verses.kjv: And they removed from Dibongad, and encamped in Almondiblathaim.
verses.modern: they set out from Dibon-gad and camped at Almon-diblathaim.

verses.kjv: And they removed from Almondiblathaim, and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
verses.modern: they set out from Almon-diblathaim and camped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

verses.kjv: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
verses.modern: they set out from the mountains of Abarim and camped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

verses.kjv: And they pitched by Jordan, from Bethjesimoth even unto Abelshittim in the plains of Moab.
verses.modern: They camped by the Jordan from Beth-jeshimoth as far as Abel-shittim in the plains of Moab.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
verses.modern: 'Speak to the people of Israel and say to them, when you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

verses.kjv: Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:
verses.modern: then You shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before You and destroy all their figured stones and destroy all their metal images and demolish all their high places.

verses.kjv: And ye shall dispossess the inhabitants of the land, and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.
verses.modern: you shall take possession of the land and settle in it, for I have given the land to You to possess it.

verses.kjv: And ye shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: and to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer ye shall give the less inheritance: every man's inheritance shall be in the place where his lot falleth; according to the tribes of your fathers ye shall inherit.
verses.modern: You shall inherit the land by lot according to your clans. To a large clan you shall give a large inheritance, and to a small clan you shall give a small inheritance. Wherever the lot falls for anyone, that shall be his. You shall inherit according to the tribes of your fathers.

verses.kjv: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them shall be pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.
verses.modern: But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then those of them whom you let remain shall be as barbs in your eyes and thorns in your sides. They shall trouble you in the land where you dwell.

verses.kjv: Moreover it shall come to pass, that I shall do unto you, as I thought to do unto them.
verses.modern: I will do to you as I thought to do to them.'

chapters.summary: Moses records the stages of Israel's journey from Rameses in Egypt to the plains of Moab, listing over forty encampments along the way. The LORD commands Israel to drive out all the inhabitants of Canaan and destroy their idols when they cross the Jordan.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan with the coasts thereof:)
verses.modern: 'Command the people of Israel and say to them, when you enter the land of Canaan, this is the land that shall fall to You for an inheritance — the land of Canaan with its boundaries —

verses.kjv: Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:
verses.modern: your south side shall be from the wilderness of Zin alongside Edom, and Your southern border shall run from the end of the Salt Sea on the east.

verses.kjv: And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin: and the going forth thereof shall be from the south to Kadeshbarnea, and shall go on to Hazaraddar, and pass on to Azmon:
verses.modern: your border shall turn south of the ascent of Akrabbim, and cross to Zin, and its limit shall be south of Kadesh-barnea. Then it shall go on to Hazar-addar and pass along to Azmon.

verses.kjv: And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.
verses.modern: the border shall turn from Azmon to the Brook of Egypt, and its limit shall be at the sea.

verses.kjv: And as for the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.
verses.modern: For the western border, You shall have the Great Sea and its coast. This shall be Your western border.

verses.kjv: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall point out for you mount Hor:
verses.modern: This shall be Your northern border: from the Great Sea You shall draw a line to Mount Hor.

verses.kjv: From mount Hor ye shall point out your border unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings forth of the border shall be to Zedad:
verses.modern: From Mount Hor You shall draw a line to the entrance of Hamath, and the limit of the border shall be at Zedad.

verses.kjv: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazarenan: this shall be your north border.
verses.modern: Then the border shall extend to Ziphron, and its limit shall be at Hazar-enan. This shall be Your northern border.

verses.kjv: And ye shall point out your east border from Hazarenan to Shepham:
verses.modern: You shall draw Your eastern border from Hazar-enan to Shepham.

verses.kjv: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:
verses.modern: the border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah on the east side of Ain. And the border shall go down and reach to the shoulder of the Sea of Chinnereth on the east.

verses.kjv: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea: this shall be your land with the coasts thereof round about.
verses.modern: the border shall go down to the Jordan, and its limit shall be at the Salt Sea. This shall be Your land with its boundaries all around.'

verses.kjv: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This is the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which the LORD commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:
verses.modern: Moses commanded the people of Israel, saying, 'This is the land that You shall inherit by lot, which the LORD has commanded to give to the nine and one-half tribes.

verses.kjv: For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received their inheritance; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:
verses.modern: For the tribe of the people of Reuben by fathers' houses and the tribe of the people of Gad by their fathers' houses have received their inheritance, and also the half-tribe of Manasseh has received its inheritance.

verses.kjv: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan near Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.
verses.modern: The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan east of Jericho, toward the sunrise.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: These are the names of the men which shall divide the land unto you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.modern: 'These are the names of the men who shall divide the land to you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun.

verses.kjv: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.
verses.modern: You shall take one chief from every tribe to divide the land for inheritance.

verses.kjv: And the names of the men are these: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.modern: These are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

verses.kjv: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
verses.modern: Of the tribe of the people of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
verses.modern: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

verses.kjv: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.
verses.modern: Of the tribe of the people of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.

verses.kjv: The prince of the children of Joseph, for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
verses.modern: Of the people of Joseph: of the tribe of the people of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.

verses.kjv: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
verses.modern: of the tribe of the people of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.

verses.kjv: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
verses.modern: Of the tribe of the people of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.

verses.kjv: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
verses.modern: Of the tribe of the people of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.

verses.kjv: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
verses.modern: Of the tribe of the people of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.

verses.kjv: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.
verses.modern: Of the tribe of the people of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.'

verses.kjv: These are they whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
verses.modern: These are the men whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance for the people of Israel in the land of Canaan.

chapters.summary: The LORD defines the boundaries of the Promised Land on all four sides -- from the wilderness of Zin in the south to Mount Hor in the north, from the Great Sea in the west to the Jordan in the east. He appoints Eleazar the priest and Joshua, along with one leader from each tribe, to divide the land.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

verses.kjv: Command the children of Israel, that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and ye shall give also unto the Levites suburbs for the cities round about them.
verses.modern: 'Command the people of Israel to give to the Levites some of the inheritance of their possession as cities to dwell in. And You shall give to the Levites pasturelands around the cities.

verses.kjv: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and the pastures of them shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.
verses.modern: The cities shall be theirs to dwell in. Their pasturelands shall be for their livestock and for their property and for all their animals.

verses.kjv: And the suburbs of the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites, shall reach from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.
verses.modern: The pasturelands of the cities, which You shall give to the Levites, shall reach from the wall of the city outward a thousand cubits all around.

verses.kjv: And ye shall measure from without the city on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits; and the city shall be in the midst: this shall be to them the suburbs of the cities.
verses.modern: you shall measure, outside the city, on the east side 2,000 cubits, on the south side 2,000 cubits, on the west side 2,000 cubits, and on the north side 2,000 cubits, the city being in the center. This shall belong to them as pastureland for their cities.

verses.kjv: And among the cities which ye shall give unto the Levites there shall be six cities for refuge, which ye shall appoint for the manslayer, that he may flee thither: and to them ye shall add forty and two cities.
verses.modern: The cities that You give to the Levites shall be the six cities of refuge, where You shall permit the manslayer to flee, and in addition to them You shall give 42 cities.

verses.kjv: So all the cities which ye shall give to the Levites shall be forty and eight cities: them shall ye give with their suburbs.
verses.modern: All the cities that You give to the Levites shall be 48, with their pasturelands.

verses.kjv: And the cities which ye shall give shall be of the possession of the children of Israel: from them that have many ye shall give many; but from them that have few ye shall give few: every one shall give of his cities unto the Levites according to his inheritance which he inheriteth.
verses.modern: as for the cities that You shall give from the possession of the people of Israel, from the larger tribes you shall take many, and from the smaller tribes You shall take few; each, in proportion to its inheritance that it inherits, shall give of its cities to the Levites.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
verses.modern: 'Speak to the people of Israel and say to them, when you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

verses.kjv: Then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, which killeth any person at unawares.
verses.modern: then You shall select cities to be cities of refuge for You, that the manslayer who kills any person without intent may flee there.

verses.kjv: And they shall be unto you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation in judgment.
verses.modern: The cities shall be for You a refuge from the avenger, that the manslayer may not die until He stands before the congregation for judgment.

verses.kjv: And of these cities which ye shall give six cities shall ye have for refuge.
verses.modern: of the cities that You give, You shall have six cities of refuge.

verses.kjv: Ye shall give three cities on this side Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan, which shall be cities of refuge.
verses.modern: You shall give three cities beyond the Jordan, and three cities in the land of Canaan, to be cities of refuge.

verses.kjv: These six cities shall be a refuge, both for the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that every one that killeth any person unawares may flee thither.
verses.modern: These six cities shall be for refuge for the people of Israel, and for the stranger and for the sojourner among them, that anyone who kills any person without intent may flee there.

verses.kjv: And if he smite him with an instrument of iron, so that he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.modern: But if He struck Him down with an iron object, so that He died, He is a murderer. The murderer shall be put to death.

verses.kjv: And if he smite him with throwing a stone, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.modern: if He struck Him down with a stone in hand, by which a man may die. He died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall be put to death.

verses.kjv: Or if he smite him with an hand weapon of wood, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.modern: Or if He struck Him down with a wooden weapon in hand, by which a man may die. He died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall be put to death.

verses.kjv: The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.
verses.modern: The avenger of blood shall Himself put the murderer to death; when He meets Him, He shall put Him to death.

verses.kjv: But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying of wait, that he die;
verses.modern: if He pushed Him out of hatred or hurled something at Him, lying in wait, so that He died,

verses.kjv: Or in enmity smite him with his hand, that he die: he that smote him shall surely be put to death; for he is a murderer: the revenger of blood shall slay the murderer, when he meeteth him.
verses.modern: or in enmity struck Him down with His hand, so that He died, then He who struck the blow shall be put to death. He is a murderer. The avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death when He meets Him.

verses.kjv: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or have cast upon him any thing without laying of wait,
verses.modern: But if He pushed Him suddenly without enmity, or hurled anything on Him without lying in wait

verses.kjv: Or with any stone, wherewith a man may die, seeing him not, and cast it upon him, that he die, and was not his enemy, neither sought his harm:
verses.modern: or used a stone that could cause death, and without seeing Him dropped it on Him, so that He died, though He was not His enemy and did not seek His harm,

verses.kjv: Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments:
verses.modern: then the congregation shall judge between the manslayer and the avenger of blood, in accordance with these rules.

verses.kjv: And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it unto the death of the high priest, which was anointed with the holy oil.
verses.modern: the congregation shall rescue the manslayer from the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall return Him to His city of refuge to which He had fled. He shall live in it until the death of the high priest who was anointed with the holy oil.

verses.kjv: But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border of the city of his refuge, whither he was fled;
verses.modern: But if the manslayer shall at any time go beyond the boundaries of His city of refuge to which He fled,

verses.kjv: And the revenger of blood find him without the borders of the city of his refuge, and the revenger of blood kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood:
verses.modern: the avenger of blood finds Him outside the boundaries of His city of refuge, and the avenger of blood kills the manslayer, He shall not be guilty of blood.

verses.kjv: Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.
verses.modern: For He must remain in His city of refuge until the death of the high priest, but after the death of the high priest the manslayer may return to the land of His possession.

verses.kjv: So these things shall be for a statute of judgment unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.modern: these things shall be for a statute and rule for You throughout Your generations in all Your dwelling places.

verses.kjv: Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person to cause him to die.
verses.modern: If anyone kills a person, the murderer shall be put to death on the evidence of witnesses. But no person shall be put to death on the testimony of one witness.

verses.kjv: Moreover ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which is guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.
verses.modern: Moreover, You shall accept no ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death. But He shall be put to death.

verses.kjv: And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.
verses.modern: you shall accept no ransom for Him who has fled to His city of refuge, that He may return to dwell in the land before the death of the high priest.

verses.kjv: So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye are: for blood it defileth the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.
verses.modern: You shall not pollute the land in which You live, for blood pollutes the land, and no atonement can be made for the land for the blood that is shed in it, except by the blood of the one who shed it.

verses.kjv: Defile not therefore the land which ye shall inhabit, wherein I dwell: for I the LORD dwell among the children of Israel.
verses.modern: You shall not defile the land in which You live, in the midst of which I dwell, for I the LORD dwell in the midst of the people of Israel.'

chapters.summary: The LORD commands Israel to give the Levites forty-eight cities with their pasturelands, including six cities of refuge where a person who kills another unintentionally may flee from the avenger of blood. The distinction between murder and manslaughter is defined, and the murderer must be put to death.

verses.kjv: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Israel:
verses.modern: The heads of the fathers' houses of the clan of the people of Gilead the son of Machir, son of Manasseh, from the clans of the people of Joseph, came near and spoke before Moses and before the chiefs, the heads of the fathers' houses of the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And they said, The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.
verses.modern: They said, 'The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the people of Israel, and my lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to His daughters.

verses.kjv: And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance.
verses.modern: But if they are married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the people of Israel, then their inheritance will be taken from the inheritance of our fathers and added to the inheritance of the tribe into which they marry, so it will be taken away from our allotted inheritance.

verses.kjv: And when the jubile of the children of Israel shall be, then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: and their inheritance shall be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.
verses.modern: when the jubilee of the people of Israel comes, then their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe into which they marry. Their inheritance will be taken from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.'

verses.kjv: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the LORD, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph hath said well.
verses.modern: Moses commanded the people of Israel according to the word of the LORD, saying, 'The tribe of the sons of Joseph is right.

verses.kjv: This is the thing which the LORD doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to whom they think best; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD commands concerning the daughters of Zelophehad: let them marry whom they think best, only they shall marry within the clan of the tribe of their father.

verses.kjv: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe: for every one of the children of Israel shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
verses.modern: The inheritance of the people of Israel shall not be transferred from one tribe to another, for every one of the people of Israel shall hold on to the inheritance of the tribe of His fathers.

verses.kjv: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.
verses.modern: every daughter who possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the people of Israel shall be wife to one of the clan of the tribe of her father, so that every one of the people of Israel may possess the inheritance of His fathers.

verses.kjv: Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance.
verses.modern: So no inheritance shall be transferred from one tribe to another, for each of the tribes of the people of Israel shall hold on to its own inheritance.'

verses.kjv: Even as the LORD commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:
verses.modern: The daughters of Zelophehad did as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father's brothers' sons:
verses.modern: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, married sons of their father's brothers.

verses.kjv: And they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
verses.modern: They were married into the clans of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph. Their inheritance remained in the tribe of their father's clan.

verses.kjv: These are the commandments and the judgments, which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
verses.modern: These are the commandments and the rules that the LORD commanded through Moses to the people of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

chapters.summary: The clan leaders of Manasseh raise a concern that the inheritance of Zelophehad's daughters will transfer to another tribe if they marry outside their tribe. The LORD commands that women who inherit land must marry within their father's tribe, and Zelophehad's daughters marry their cousins.
